Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

Description:
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.
Job Summery
Location:
Manipur, India
Qualification:
Diploma or BE in EEE/ECE
Experience:
0 to 1 Year or willing to work as service technician.

2. Maintain accurate and up-to-date student records, including transcripts, enrollment verifications, and degree audits.

4. Collaborate with academic departments to ensure course offerings and scheduling meet institutional standards.
5. Administer and interpret institutional policies related to enrollment and student records.
Requirements:
1. Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
2. Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
3. Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
4. Ability to analyze and interpret data.
5. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Description:
Job Description Sales Head (Manipur)
Position: Sales Head
Location: Manipur
Experience: 5+ Years
Salary: 5–50 LPA, based on experience, market exposure, and relevant industry expertise
Profile:
Target-Based SalesAbout the RoleWe are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Sales Head to lead and expand our sales operations in Manipur. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in the sales of Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler Batteries, Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.The candidate should have excellent knowledge of the Manipur market, strong dealer and distributor networks, and the ability to achieve sales targets through effective market development and channel management.Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Lead and manage sales activities across the Manipur market.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, retailers, and customers.
Identify and appoint new dealers and distributors to expand market presence.
Manage and strengthen existing dealer and distributor networks.
Regularly visit the market to understand market trends, customer requirements, competitor activities, and business opportunities.
Drive sales of Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler/Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
Generate new business opportunities and expand the company's customer base.
Negotiate with dealers, distributors, and customers regarding pricing, orders, schemes, and commercial terms.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions wherever required.
Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, product availability, dispatches, payments, and customer support.
Prepare regular sales reports, market updates, and sales forecasts for management.
Monitor competitor pricing, products, schemes, and market activities.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments from dealers and distributors.
Required Experience
5+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or Channel Sales.
Relevant experience in Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler Batteries, Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
Strong experience in dealer and distributor handling.
Proven track record of achieving target-based sales.
Strong understanding of the Manipur market.
Required Skills
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Strong knowledge of market development and channel management.
Ability to effectively deal with dealers, distributors, retailers, and customers.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Good understanding of sales targets, business development, and revenue generation.
Strong networking and relationship-management abilities.
Willingness to travel extensively across the market.
Ability to work in a highly target-oriented environment.
Compensation5 LPA to 50 LPA, depending on experience, market exposure, existing dealer/distributor network, industry knowledge, and sales performance.Preferred Candidate ProfileCandidates who have a strong existing network of dealers and distributors in Manipur and proven experience in Lithium Batteries, Inverters, Solar Batteries, Two-Wheeler/Three-Wheeler Batteries, or related products will be highly preferred.How to ApplyInterested candidates can share their updated CV on: hr@spinoff.in

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Social Media Executive to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.A Social Media Executive is responsible for planning, executing, and managing social media campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This role involves developing and maintaining a strong online presence for a company across multiple social media platforms, creating engaging content, and analyzing the success of social media efforts.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
2. Create and publish engaging and relevant content for multiple social media platforms, including but not limited to, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
3. Manage and grow the company's social media presence, including daily monitoring and responding to comments, messages, and reviews.
4. Analyze and report on the success of social media campaigns, using metrics such as likes, shares, comments, and reach to continually improve and refine strategies.
5. Manage and maintain the company's social media calendar, ensuring that content is planned and scheduled in advance.
Requirements:
1. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and engaging content.
2. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
3. A creative and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to continuously improve social media strategies.
4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
5. A strong understanding of brand messaging, tone, and voice, and the ability to consistently maintain a cohesive brand image across all social media channels.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence Developer

Description:
Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, or Hyderabad.
Word Mode: 2 Days weekly WFO
Interview: 3 rounds virtual.
Notice: Immediate
Code: 108260-42
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Sr. Developer
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Developer with strong hands-on expertise in AMPscript, CloudPages, SQL, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting personalized marketing communications, landing pages, data-driven campaigns, and automated customer journeys within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role requires strong technical development skills as well as the ability to translate business and marketing requirements into scalable SFMC solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Develop personalized and dynamic email content using AMPscript.
Build and maintain CloudPages, landing pages, microsites, forms, preference centers, and subscription-management pages.
Develop server-side functionality on CloudPages using AMPscript and Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) where applicable.
Create dynamic forms and landing pages that read from and write data to Data Extensions.
Implement form submission, validation, data capture, confirmation pages, and error-handling logic.
Develop secure and personalized CloudPages using URL parameters, encrypted query strings, subscriber attributes, and Data Extension lookups.
Build reusable AMPscript components for personalization, conditional content, data retrieval, data updates, and campaign logic.
Develop complex SQL queries for audience segmentation, campaign targeting, reporting, and data transformation.
Design and manage Data Extensions, subscriber data, Contact Builder relationships, and SFMC data architecture.
Develop and maintain automated processes using Automation Studio, including SQL Query Activities, imports, extracts, file transfers, and scheduled workflows.
Build and support customer journeys using Journey Builder, including entry events, decision splits, personalization, triggered communications, and journey data.
Develop responsive HTML email templates and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Integrate Salesforce Marketing Cloud with Salesforce CRM and other enterprise platforms using Marketing Cloud Connect, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, SFTP, and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot AMPscript, CloudPages, automations, journeys, email rendering, and data-related issues.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, deployment validation, and production support.
Develop reusable technical components and follow development standards for security, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
Maintain technical documentation for CloudPages, data models, APIs, automations, journeys, and integrations.
Work closely with marketing, business, technology, and data teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
Strong proficiency in AMPscript, including:
Personalization
Conditional logic
Lookup functions
Data Extension reads and updates
Subscriber and contact attributes
String, date, and formatting functions
Redirects and URL handling
Error handling
Dynamic content
Strong hands-on experience developing CloudPages.
Experience developing:
Landing pages
Lead capture forms
Registration forms
Preference centers
Unsubscribe pages
Confirmation and thank-you pages
Dynamic personalized pages
Experience using AMPscript functions such as Lookup, LookupRows, RetrieveSalesforceObjects, UpsertData, InsertData, UpdateData, RequestParameter, Redirect, CloudPagesURL, and related functions.
Strong SQL skills for segmentation, data transformation, and audience management.
Hands-on experience with:
Content Builder
Email Studio
Journey Builder
Automation Studio
Contact Builder
Data Extensions
Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Understanding of responsive email and web development.
Experience integrating SFMC with external systems using REST and/or SOAP APIs.
Experience with SFTP-based file integrations and automated data processing.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
Understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud subscriber, contact, and consent-management concepts.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Experience with CloudPages security and secure data handling.
Experience implementing encrypted and personalized URLs using CloudPagesURL.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM through Marketing Cloud Connect.
Familiarity with JSON and API-based integrations.
Experience building custom preference centers and consent-management solutions.
Knowledge of email deliverability and subscriber-management best practices.
Understanding of CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and related data-privacy requirements.
Experience with enterprise-scale Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementations.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications are preferred.
Experience
8+ years of Salesforce Marketing Cloud development experience preferred.
6+ years of hands-on AMPscript development experience.
Demonstrated experience designing and developing CloudPages and custom landing-page solutions.
Experience supporting production marketing campaigns, automated journeys, and enterprise-scale customer communications.

Description:
ETL Testing Engineer
Job Title
ETL Testing Engineer / Data Warehouse Tester
Experience
3 -10 Years
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled ETL Testing Engineer to validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes in data warehouse and business intelligence environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong SQL skills, hands-on ETL testing experience, and expertise in data validation and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business and technical requirements related to data migration and ETL processes.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test scenarios.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems to target databases.
Perform data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation testing.
Verify data mappings, transformation rules, and business logic.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects through defect management tools.
Perform regression, integration, system, and UAT support testing.
Validate data quality and consistency across multiple platforms.
Collaborate with developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test metrics, reports, and test execution status updates.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of ETL Testing concepts and methodologies.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as:
Informatica
SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
Talend
DataStage
Ab Initio
Advanced SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation.
Experience with Data Warehouse concepts including:
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Fact and Dimension Tables
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
Experience with database platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Teradata.
Expertise in data quality and data migration testing.
Familiarity with defect tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
Preferred Skills
Automation experience using Python, Selenium, or ETL automation frameworks.
Experience with cloud data platforms:
Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Azure Synapse
AWS Glue
Snowflake
Databricks
Knowledge of Big Data technologies (Hive, Hadoop, Spark).
Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
Performance and volume testing experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Certification in ETL, Data Warehousing, or Database technologies is a plus.

Description:
Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Role: Workday Recruiting Consultant
Exp: 2 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM, Recruiting certification.
Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up Questionnaires, Job requisitions, Evergreen Requisitions.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring Job Posting Templates, Career Sites, Job Applications Business Process while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on configuring Referrals, Prospects, Candidates.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent.

In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Advanced Compensation, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Core Skills---

SAP S/4HANA Expertise
Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA modules including Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing

Negotiation and influencing skills for driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
Experience Requirement
Certification Requirements
SAP Certified Professional Enterprise Architect (P_SAPEA_2023) or equivalent
SAP S/4HANA implementation and migration certifications SAP BTP Solution Architect certification preferred
TOGAF or similar enterprise architecture framework certification recommended

Solution Design
Create comprehensive technical blueprints covering processes, integration, extensibility, and data management strategies
Validate IT scope and approve/reject requirements based on architectural feasibility and business value
Stakeholder Engagement
Conduct solution architecture workshops and present recommendations to executive leadership
Gather and validate business requirements while identifying gaps in current system landscape
Provide architectural advisory services and best practice guidance to implementation teams
Success Metrics
Successful delivery of S/4HANA implementations within scope, timeline, and budget parameters
Client satisfaction scores reflecting solution quality and architectural guidance effectiveness
Team development indicators including knowledge transfer and skill enhancement
Technical excellence benchmarks including system performance, scalability

Description:
We have an opportunity to have SAP BTP Administrator - Integration & AI Transformation Manager
Position: SAP BTP Administrator - Integration
Experience Required: 10-16 Years
Notice Period: Immediate to 60 Days
Locations: Bangalore, Hyderabad & Chennai
Work Timing: Rotational Shifts (2 To 11)
Required Skills:
1. Design and implement real-time integration strategies connecting SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and Ariba to ensure seamless data flow across systems.
2. Deploy and manage SAP AI Core and Generative AI technologies to automate and optimize core business processes.
3. Govern and oversee API management and event-driven architectures using SAP Event Mesh to enable scalable and secure integrations.
4. Architect and maintain robust data orchestration pipelines between cloud platforms and hyperscaler environments.
5. Administer SAP Integration Suite and Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) to build, monitor, and troubleshoot integration scenarios.
6. Develop, deploy, and maintain machine learning models using SAP AI Launchpad and related AI tools to support business needs.
7. Ensure compliance and efficient usage of communication protocols such as REST, SOAP, OData, EDI, and GraphQL in all integration workflows.
8. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify automation opportunities leveraging AI and integration technologies.
9. Monitor system performance and provide continuous improvements for integration flows and AI deployments within the SAP BTP environment.
10. Maintain documentation, provide training and support to stakeholders on SAP BTP administration, API governance, and AI-enabled automation solutions.Experience in SAP Technical Pre-Sales including creation of technical proposals and constructing estimates for SAP Technical work.
11. Knowledge on SAP cloud offerings like BTP, SAC, Cloud connector, etc.
12. Full cycle experience in SAP Migration and S/4 Conversion activities.
13. Strong knowledge and exposure to HANA Database and MS SQL Database.
14. Strong knowledge in BOBI, Data services etc.
15. Proficient in the use of methodologies supported by SAP best practices.
16. Strong knowledge in troubleshooting performance issues and providing solutions to fine tune the system.
17. Must be proactive and self-motivated.
18. Must be easily understood and possess excellent English communication skills, both verbal and writing skills.
19. Must Have customer facing experience and possess good negotiation skills.
20. Exposure to ITIL framework.
21. Provide SME advice to the team and Mentor team members to achieve the desired result by conducting Boot camps, learning sessions, etc.
22. Should have a good understanding of the organization structure and requirements.
23. Develop and maintain process and technical documentation.
24. Prepare and present project status reports to Clients and Senior Management.
25. Must have experience in working with cross functional and cross cultural teams across the globe.
26. Should provide escalation support and ensure all the tasks and issues are resolved within the deadline.

Description:
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Saleforce DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Salesforce DevOps practices and tools such as Copado, Git, and Azure DevOps (ADO). The candidate will play a key role in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines, enabling efficient, reliable, and scalable release management across Salesforce environments.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce using Copado and ADO.
Manage source control strategy with Git (branching, merging, conflict resolution).
Automate deployments across multiple Salesforce environments, ensuring alignment with governance and compliance requirements.
Collaborate with development teams to define DevOps best practices and enforce coding standards.
Support release management activities, including planning, monitoring, and issue resolution.
Integrate testing, code quality checks, and security scans into the deployment pipeline.
Provide troubleshooting support for deployment issues and perform root cause analysis.
Create documentation, knowledge base articles, and training to upskill development teams.
Work closely with stakeholders (functional, technical, QA, and business) to ensure seamless delivery.
Required Skills & Experience
48 years of overall IT experience with 3+ years in Salesforce DevOps.
Hands-on experience with Copado (mandatory).
Strong knowledge of Git-based workflows (feature branching, pull requests, code review).
Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines and work item tracking.
Familiarity with Salesforce metadata, SFDX, and package-based deployments.
Knowledge of release management processes in large-scale enterprise environments.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot deployment failures.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Gearset, AutoRABIT, or other Salesforce DevOps tools.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization concepts.
Knowledge of test automation tools (Selenium, Provar, etc.) integrated with CI/CD.
Salesforce certifications (Admin/Platform Developer) and Copado certifications.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.


Location

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida


Perks and benefits
https://www.apple.com/careers/in/life-at-apple.html
AboutCompany: Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV. Apple's software platforms provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV+.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
About the company
NoBroker.com is the world's largest C2C marketplace in online real estate. With a cumulative 85 lakh customers, it has grown 10X in the last one year. With three rounds of funding of $151 mn, it is well funded by key US, Indian, Japanese & Korean investors like General Atlantic,Tiger Global Partners, KTB ventures and BeeNext. It is headquartered in Bangalore with a team of 4000+ employees.

Qualification / Education and other Requirements:
EducationAny Undergraduate (BBA,B.Tech, B,A) etc.
Excellent verbal and written communication.
Good Interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability. Decision making skills.
Language required: English & Hindi or English, Hindi & 1 South Regional Language (Kan, Tel, Tam)
Proficient in MS-Office (Excel, Word).
Should be flexible for day shift- (9-hour of login between 8 AM - 10 PM). Comfortable with working 6 days a week and the week off will be on weekdays.

Role and Responsibility Relationship Manager

Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.
Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication.
Identify and assess customers' needs to effectively upsell or cross-sell relevant products or services.
Service customer in finding the right tenant / house as per the requirement of the customer.
Dial outbound and attend inbound calls of customers and leads.
Use internal tools and methods to provide the best possible service to the customer.
Negotiate with leads on behalf of customers. Keep customers up-to-date on the progress of his account.
Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Go extra mile to provide excellent customer service

Employee Value Proposition:
Employee health insurance of Rs 1 lakh per year.
Premium is paid by the company.
Monthly reward and recognition to outstanding performers. based . Regular team parties and Annual Day outing for all employees.

Department: Servicing
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at
Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and
sell properties !!!
Location
:
:
:
Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Full-time
Position Type
¢ Salary Range

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long term
engagement.
Understand customer needs and assist in finding the right tenant or property with tailored
solutions.
Manage inbound and outbound calls, negotiate with leads, and provide regular updates
on account progress.
Utilize internal tools and adhere to company guidelines to deliver efficient and high-
quality service.
Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer
satisfaction.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and

billion.

drive conversions.

Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.

years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.

Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.

Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

:

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.

Prospect Identification: Identify and engage potential business opportunities.
Sales and Relationships: Build strong client relationships and effectively
communicate product value.
Problem Solving: Address client challenges with tailored solutions.

drive conversions.
Service Excellence: Maintain high service standards to ensure client satisfaction.
Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Description:
Customer Service Executive

Department: Customer Servicing

Are you a people-first individual who enjoys helping customers and solving problems? Join our team at NoBroker as a Customer Service Executive and be the trusted voice that helps our customers through their property journey!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.28 LPA to 5.05 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us

NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long-term engagement.
Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 3–4 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer service process.
Understand customer needs and assist in resolving queries and finding the right tenant or property, with a strong focus on customer experience rather than hard sales targets.
Provide regular, proactive updates on account/service progress and utilize internal tools while adhering to company guidelines for high-quality service delivery.
Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer satisfaction; performance is monitored though the role is not heavily target-based.

Perks & Value Proposition

Performance incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of up to 15,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education: Graduation, HSC (12th) or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: 6-day working week — Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-driven real estate platform that simplifies property-related services. NoBroker Interiors offers interior design solutions to homeowners, helping them transform their spaces through functional planning and thoughtfully designed interiors.

Job Summary
We are looking for creative, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented freshers to join our NoBroker Interiors team in Pune. The candidate will work on residential interior design projects, assisting with space planning, 2D layouts, 3D visualizations, material selection, and design coordination.
This role is ideal for fresh graduates who are passionate about interior design and want to build their careers in the residential interiors industry.

Key Responsibilities
Assist in designing residential interiors, including living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and wardrobes.
Prepare 2D floor plans, furniture layouts, and interior design drawings.
Create 3D designs and visualizations based on client requirements.
Understand client preferences, functional needs, and design expectations.
Assist in selecting materials, finishes, colors, furniture, and accessories.
Coordinate with design, sales, project execution, and other internal teams.
Support site visits, measurements, and verification of site dimensions as required.
Incorporate client feedback and make design revisions.
Ensure designs meet functional requirements, space optimization goals, and project specifications.

Required Skills
Degree or diploma in Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field.
Freshers and recent graduates are welcome to apply.
Basic understanding of residential interior design and space planning.
Working knowledge of AutoCAD is preferred.
Familiarity with SketchUp, 3ds Max, V-Ray, Enscape, or similar visualization tools is an advantage.
Understanding of furniture layouts, materials, finishes, and interior design concepts.
Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Creativity, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

Candidate Profile
Passionate about interior design and residential spaces.
Able to understand design briefs and translate them into practical layouts.
Comfortable working in a collaborative, target-driven environment.
Willing to learn and adapt to project requirements.
Portfolio or academic interior design projects are an advantage.

Why Join NoBroker Interiors?
Opportunity to work on real residential interior design projects.
Hands-on exposure to design planning and customer requirements.
Learn from experienced professionals in the interiors industry.
Build practical skills in a fast-paced, technology-driven organization.

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume and design portfolio, if available.

Description:
Driving Innovation: Join Us as a Retail Associate (Field Role) at Cars24!
Apply Now
Contact Person: Kavita Dangwal
Team: People & Culture | CARS24
Phone: 9311243497
Email: kavita.dangwal@cars24.com
Locations: Vadodara, Surat, Faridabad, Noida ,Ranchi, Mumbai
What will you drive?
As a Retail Associate, your primary responsibility will be to build strong relationships with New Car Dealerships (NCDs)and generate high-quality leads for customers looking to sell or exchange their cars.
Your day will revolve around visiting 3-5 NCD outlets daily, engaging with dealer partners, and identifying customers interested in selling their old vehicles or opting for exchange deals. You will act as the face of CARS24 on the ground ensuring that every potential lead is captured, nurtured, and converted through our platform.
This role is not just about visits its about consistent follow-ups, relationship management, and closing deals. Strong coordination with dealers and timely follow-ups on leads will be critical to your success.
You will work towards monthly targets, where your performance will be measured based on lead generation, conversions, and dealer engagement quality. Your persuasion and negotiation skills will play a key role in turning opportunities into successful transactions.
To set you up for success, you will go through 715 days of structured training(classroom + on-field), equipping you with the right product knowledge, sales techniques, and tools.
Expect a high-performance environment with attractive incentives tied to your achievements because at CARS24, we celebrate results and reward top performers.

Key Responsibilities
Visit4-6 Dealerships daily to generate leads
Identify customers interested in selling or exchanging their cars
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealer partners
Ensure consistent follow-ups with NCDs for lead flow
Convert leads into successful transactions via CARS24
Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions
Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Working Days
6 days a week
Week off during weekdays

Who are we looking for?
Strong field sales mindset with willingness to travel daily
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Ability to follow up persistently and close deals
Self-driven, target-oriented, and highly energetic
Prior experience in automobile, dealership, or field sales is a plus

NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. Job Title: Mechanical Draftsman (Bulk Material Handling & Air Pollution Control Equipment)
Location: Mumbai- Central suburb
Department: Design & Engineering

About the Company:
Fourteckh Enviro India Pvt. Ltd. is a leading engineering firm specializing in the design and manufacture of Bulk Material Handling Systems, Air Pollution Control Equipment, and Process Equipment. With 29 years of experience and a global presence, our products serve a wide range of industries including Steel, Cement, Power, Fertilizer, Pharma, Oil & Gas, and Chemicals.

Job Summary:
The Mechanical Draftsman will be responsible for preparing detailed fabrication and assembly drawings, bill of materials (BOMs), and layout drawings for mechanical systems and components. The role requires strong CAD skills, attention to detail, and familiarity with industrial equipment.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare 3D / 2D fabrication, layout, and assembly drawings for:
Bag filters, Screw conveyors, Bucket elevators, Belt conveyors, Rotary Air Lock valves
Cyclone separators, Valves (Rotary, Double Flap, Shut-off, etc.), Dampers, Gates, Pneumatic systems, Piping drawings

Generate accurate Bill of Materials (BOM) for manufacturing and procurement.
Modify and revise existing drawings based on engineering changes or feedback.
Assist design engineers in converting concepts and calculations into working drawings.
Ensure all drawings adhere to industry standards and customer specifications.
Maintain a proper drawing numbering and filing system for design documentation.
Coordinate with production/shop floor / site team to resolve drawing-related issues.
Update drawings for as-built documentation after completion of projects.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Education: ITI/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Drafting Technology
Experience: 4-6 years in mechanical drafting for heavy engineering or process equipment
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in AutoCAD (2D essential); 3D is a plus with Solid works or Creo or Inventor.
Familiarity with fabricated and machined components, fabrication and assembly techniques, and weld symbols, piping.
Knowledge of basic mechanical standards (IS, ANSI, etc.)
Candidates should be ready to visit site occasionally when required.


Soft Skills:
High attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and under guidance
Good communication and coordination skills


Preferred Background:
Experience in drafting for equipment used in Steel Plants, Mining, Cement Plants, Power Plants, Bulk Material Handling Systems, or Air Pollution Control Systems will be advantageous.


Please send your CV: to response@fourteckhenviro.com
Contact: Cell 7506668477
AboutCompany:
Since 1997, Fourteckh Enviro (I) Pvt. Ltd. has been a global partner in optimizing industrial workflows. We specialize in high-reliability solutions for Bulk Material Handling, Flow Control, and Air Pollution Control.
Our hallmark is innovation. We are pioneers in Dry Beneficiation of Iron Ore using Lean Phase Pneumatic Conveyinga cutting-edge technology we successfully implemented for one of India’s leading mining majors. As an ISO 9001:2015 certified company, we combine decades of experience with in-house engineering, software and state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities to deliver excellence.

Description:
About EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance practice supports global EY client-serving teams with their reviews across industry sectors, including financial services, manufacturing, and technology, among others. Through the right multidisciplinary team of professionals with the sector knowledge and subject matter expertise, EY GDS Assurance enables EY client teams in over 30 countries to help worlds leading companies meet their assurance requirements

Job purpose:
The role of a Trainee/ Consultant is to carry out routine substantive and controls-based testing for the GDS Assurance multinational clients. Clients are primarily based in the various countries of Europe and the US. Key challenges for the role are to provide high quality results to the local team, often to a tight deadline

Locations- Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Kochi, Noida, Pune,Trivandrum

Contract Duration: 3 months

Responsibilities:
Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific procedures as defined by the engagement objectives, onshore teams work step allocation, and planned approach
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues or accounting risks
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the GDS Senior/Manager
Collaborate with GDS and local team members to set goals and responsibilities
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the GDS & local GDS assurance team.
Mandatory Educational requirement:
Part Qualified ACCA(9/13) /CPA(2/4) completed
Article ship completed (For CA candidates)
Should be a Graduate (B.Com, BBA)

Additional skills requirements:
Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping
Good written and oral communication skills
AboutCompany:
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Description:
Job Location - Noida

To qualify for the role, you must have
B.Com Graduates with 1 - 2 years of relevant experience in financial accounting and assurance concepts.
ACCA / CPA qualified fresher are eligible

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you will be carrying out routine substantive and controls-based procedures from the GDS India offices supporting the various Global client serving assurance teams mostly based in the Americas & European countries.

The opportunity
Were looking for candidates with good exposure and work experience in accounting and assurance concepts. The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles.

Your key responsibilities
Be responsible for delivering highest quality deliverables on assurance related tasks which comply to EY Global methodology.
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues or assurance risks.
Interact with the global engagement team on a regular basis and develop productive working relationship with them.
Contribute ideas for improvement by comparing efficiency of review procedures performed across different clients.
Contributes to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism towards work challenges.
Promote EYs ethical and professional standards, including data confidentiality.
Achieve participation on calls with EY Onshore teams.
Develop knowledge of use of EY technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.

Skills and attributes for success
Strong interpersonal and good written & oral communication skills.
Proficient with MS office and Outlook
Robust logical and reasoning skills
Team player, with the ability to multi-task, flexible and can work under pressure.
Commitment to continuous learning and proactively implement onto new processes
Team player, with the ability to multi-task, flexible and can work under pressure.


Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Role & Responsibilities

Handle daily invoicing and billing for logistics and transportation services.
Upload invoices and supporting documents on MNC customer portals within prescribed timelines.
Verify freight rates, LR copies, PODs, and other documents before invoice submission.
Maintain day-to-day accounting entries using Tally and company software.(Tally Optional)
Track customer outstanding payments, invoice due dates, and overdue amounts.
Regularly follow up with customer finance teams through email and telephone for payment releases.
Monitor invoice acceptance, rejection, payment status, and portal-related issues.
Prepare customer-wise outstanding statements, invoice ageing reports, and MIS reports.
Perform customer ledger reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and basic GST-related documentation.
Coordinate with operations and documentation teams to resolve billing discrepancies and missing documents.
Maintain accurate accounting records and perform other accounts-related duties assigned by management.

Preferred Candidate Profile

B.Com or equivalent commerce qualification preferred.
25 years of relevant experience in accounting, billing, or accounts receivable.
Good working knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime (Tally Optional) and MS Excel.
Experience in MNC customer portals, invoice processing, and payment follow-ups is preferred.
Candidates from logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, or manufacturing industries will be given preference.
Good communication skills for professional email correspondence and payment follow-ups.
Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and accuracy in accounting documentation.
Ability to manage multiple invoices, deadlines, and customer accounts independently.
Honest, responsible, proactive, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.

Perks and Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
Company reimbursement for eligible monthly fuel expenses, as per company policy.
Group health insurance coverage under the company's applicable policy.
Opportunity to work with reputed multinational and industrial clients.
Stable, full-time employment with opportunities to learn and grow.
Supportive working environment with exposure to logistics operations, accounting systems, and MNC billing processes.
AboutCompany:
M.J. & SONS SURAT is a proud member of the MJ Group, engaged in road transportation and logistics services for reputed multinational corporations (MNCs) and industrial clients. With over three decades of industry experience, the company focuses on reliable logistics solutions, professional service, and long-term customer relationships.
Our services include road transportation, pan-India logistics, specialised and over-dimensional cargo movement, and transportation solutions under rate contracts. We are committed to ethical business practices, operational efficiency, transparency, and customer satisfaction.
At M.J. & SONS SURAT, we believe our people are an important part of our success. We offer opportunities to work with established industrial clients, develop professional skills, and grow within a business that values accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
CompanyAddress: 1St Floo, 111, Siddhi Plaza, Hazira Road, Hazira, Surat, Gujarat, 394510, SURAT, Gujarat, India

Role & Responsibilities

Coordinate with MNC customers to understand and fulfil their daily transportation and logistics requirements.
Receive transport indents, vehicle requirements, dispatch schedules, and delivery instructions from customers.
Coordinate with the existing operations team and transporters to ensure timely vehicle placement and smooth execution of transport orders.
Maintain professional relationships with customer logistics, dispatch, and supply chain teams.
Participate in customer portal activities, including freight rate submissions, online bidding, and e-auctions, as required.
Monitor customer portals for new requirements, bidding deadlines, and awarded transport orders.
Coordinate with management for freight rate approvals and commercial decisions before submitting quotations or participating in auctions.
Operate the company's internal logistics software for transport entries, workflow management, shipment updates, and operational tracking.
Track vehicle placement, loading, dispatch, transit, and delivery status, and provide timely updates to customers.
Coordinate with drivers, vehicle owners, transporters, and internal staff to resolve operational issues and delivery delays.
Ensure proper preparation and collection of LR copies, PODs, and other transportation documents.
Prepare daily operational reports covering pending indents, vehicle placement, dispatches, deliveries, and outstanding operational issues.
Coordinate with the accounts and billing teams to resolve documentation discrepancies and support timely invoicing.
Perform other logistics and transport-related responsibilities assigned by management.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Graduate in any discipline; B.Com, BBA, or a logistics-related qualification preferred.
15 years of experience in logistics coordination, road transportation, dispatch, or transport operations.
Experience dealing with MNC customers, industrial clients, or corporate logistics teams will be an advantage.
Knowledge of vehicle placement, transporter coordination, freight rates, and dispatch management preferred.
Prior experience with customer portals, freight bidding, or e-auctions is desirable but not mandatory. Training will be provided where required.
Basic to good working knowledge of MS Excel, email, and computer-based applications.
Willingness to learn and operate the company's internal logistics software and customer-specific portals.
Good communication, coordination, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple transport requirements, follow deadlines, and coordinate effectively with customers and internal teams.
Responsible, proactive, organised, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of ownership.

Perks and Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience, skills, and suitability.
Monthly fuel expense reimbursement for eligible business-related expenses, as per company policy.
Group health insurance coverage under the company's applicable policy.
Opportunity to work with reputed multinational companies and industrial customers.
Practical exposure to transport operations, freight bidding, customer portals, and logistics management.
Learning and career growth opportunities within the logistics and transportation industry.
Professional working environment with opportunities to take on greater responsibilities based on performance.
AboutCompany:
M.J. & SONS SURAT is a proud member of the MJ Group, engaged in road transportation and logistics services for reputed multinational corporations (MNCs) and industrial clients. With over three decades of industry experience, the company focuses on reliable logistics solutions, professional service, and long-term customer relationships.
Our services include road transportation, pan-India logistics, specialised and over-dimensional cargo movement, and transportation solutions under rate contracts. We are committed to ethical business practices, operational efficiency, transparency, and customer satisfaction.
At M.J. & SONS SURAT, we believe our people are an important part of our success. We offer opportunities to work with established industrial clients, develop professional skills, and grow within a business that values accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
CompanyAddress: 1St Floo, 111, Siddhi Plaza, Hazira Road, Hazira, Surat, Gujarat, 394510, SURAT, Gujarat, India

Description:
About EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance practice supports global EY client-serving teams with their reviews across industry sectors, including financial services, manufacturing, and technology, among others. Through the right multidisciplinary team of professionals with the sector knowledge and subject matter expertise, EY GDS Assurance enables EY client teams in over 30 countries to help worlds leading companies meet their assurance requirements

Job purpose:
The role of a Trainee/ Consultant is to carry out routine substantive and controls-based testing for the GDS Assurance multinational clients. Clients are primarily based in the various countries of Europe and the US. Key challenges for the role are to provide high quality results to the local team, often to a tight deadline

Locations- Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Kochi, Noida, Pune, Trivandrum

Contract Duration: 3 months

Responsibilities:

Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific procedures as defined by the engagement objectives, onshore teams work step allocation, and planned approach
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues or accounting risks
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the GDS Senior/Manager
Collaborate with GDS and local team members to set goals and responsibilities
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the GDS & local GDS assurance team.

Mandatory Educational requirement:
CA Freshers / CA Inter
Article ship completed (For CA candidates)
Should be a Graduate (B.Com, BBA)

Additional skills requirements:
Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping
Good written and oral communication skills
AboutCompany:
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
