Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical professional with experience in Direct Tax, Accounting, and Auditing to support Canadian tax compliance and advisory engagements. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of taxation principles, financial statements, and audit procedures, along with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and review Canadian Corporate Tax Returns (T2) and related tax schedules.
Analyze financial statements and supporting documents for tax compliance.
Perform tax provisions, tax reconciliations, and identify tax-saving opportunities.
Assist in tax research and interpretation of Canadian tax legislation.
Work closely with audit and accounting teams to gather financial information required for tax filings.
Review general ledger accounts, trial balances, and year-end financial statements.
Support tax audits, notices, and queries from the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA).
Ensure compliance with tax deadlines and internal quality standards.
Prepare work papers, tax calculations, and documentation for review.
Participate in client discussions and provide tax-related support as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or Taxation.
CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
2-7 years of experience in Direct Tax, Accounting, and/or Auditing.
Experience in preparing corporate tax returns and reviewing financial statements.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and audit procedures.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel.

Preferred Skills

Experience working on Canadian Tax engagements.
Exposure to tax software such as CaseWare, TaxPrep, CCH, or similar tools.
Knowledge of GST/HST, corporate tax provisions, and tax compliance processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Role & responsibilities

Description:
Role & responsibilities
A Process Executive / Operation Executive at Delhivery Limited manages daily supply chain, warehouse, and logistics workflows to ensure on-time delivery and operational accuracy.

Key Responsibilities
Order Fulfillment & Warehouse Operations: Oversee sorting, scanning, bag handling, picking, packing, and shipping of packages.
Shipment & Logistics Monitoring: Track incoming and outgoing consignments, monitor Turnaround Times (TAT), and address transit delays or damaged items.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain digital and physical records, create shipping/customs forms (bills of lading), and compile daily Management Information System (MIS) reports.
Process & Compliance Enforcement: Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety standards, and facility security guidelines.
Team & Vendor Coordination: Support team leads, train ground staff or field executives, and coordinate with internal departments or external transport partners.


Preferred candidate profile
Education: Graduate or student pursuing a degree in business, supply chain management, logistics, or commerce.
Technical Skills: Familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), basic computer operations, and data entry/MIS reporting.
Operational Skills: Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and readiness to work in rotational or shift-based environments.
Benefits: Typically includes statutory benefits such as Employees' State Insurance (ESI), and Provident Fund (EPF)

Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical professional with experience in Direct Tax, Accounting, and Auditing to support Canadian tax compliance and advisory engagements. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of taxation principles, financial statements, and audit procedures, along with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze financial statements and supporting documents for tax compliance.
Perform tax provisions, tax reconciliations, and identify tax-saving opportunities.
Assist in tax research and interpretation of Canadian tax legislation.
Work closely with audit and accounting teams to gather financial information required for tax filings.
Review general ledger accounts, trial balances, and year-end financial statements.
Support tax audits, notices, and queries from the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA).
Ensure compliance with tax deadlines and internal quality standards.
Prepare work papers, tax calculations, and documentation for review.
Participate in client discussions and provide tax-related support as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or Taxation.
CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
2-7 years of experience in Direct Tax, Accounting, and/or Auditing.
Experience in preparing corporate tax returns and reviewing financial statements.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and audit procedures.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of GST/HST, corporate tax provisions, and tax compliance processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Executive to join our Gold and Silver business. The candidate will be responsible for handling customer enquiries, promoting gold and silver products, developing new business opportunities, maintaining customer relationships, and achieving sales targets.
Key Responsibilities:
Identify and approach potential customers and generate new sales leads.
Promote and sell gold and silver products to customers and business clients.
Explain product quality, purity, weight, pricing, and market rates.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new customers.
Handle customer enquiries, follow up on leads, and close sales.
Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to business growth.
Coordinate with internal teams for order processing and timely delivery.
Maintain customer databases and prepare regular sales reports.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and gold and silver price movements.
Required Skills:
Good communication and negotiation skills.
Strong customer relationship and sales skills.
Ability to generate leads and achieve sales targets.
Basic knowledge of gold and silver products is preferred.
Basic computer and MS Excel knowledge.
Positive attitude, confidence, and willingness to learn.
Qualification: 12th Pass / Diploma / Any Graduate.
Experience: Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Department: Sales & Business Development.
Industry: Gems & Jewellery / Gold & Silver Trading.
Employment Type: Full-Time.
Salary: As per company standards, with incentives based on performance if applicable.


Perks and benefits
Annual bonus
AboutCompany:
Harivallabhi Jewellers and Sarees LLP is a jewellery and saree retail business based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The company offers a range of gold and silver jewellery, including traditional and contemporary designs, along with sarees for various occasions.
At Harivallabhi, we focus on providing quality products, excellent customer service, and a satisfying shopping experience. We aim to build long-term customer relationships through trust, transparency, and a wide selection of products to meet diverse customer preferences.
We are looking for enthusiastic and customer-oriented professionals who want to grow their careers in sales, jewellery retail, and customer relationship management.

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Relationship Manager to handle voice-based sales interactions. The role involves engaging with potential customers, understanding their property needs, and providing suitable solutions for renting, buying, or selling through our platform.



Key Responsibilities

Handle inbound and outbound calls with prospective customers
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable properties
Build strong relationships and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction
Guide customers through the end-to-end real estate journey
Achieve sales targets and drive revenue growth
Follow up with leads and maintain regular communication
Coordinate with internal teams for seamless service delivery
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions in CRM


Eligibility Criteria

Any graduate (Freshers & experienced candidates can apply)

We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Relationship Manager to handle voice-based sales interactions. The role involves engaging with potential customers, understanding their property needs, and providing suitable solutions for renting, buying, or selling through our platform.

Maintain accurate records of customer interactions in CRM

AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

NoBroker is India's first and largest prop-tech unicorn. Our Packers & Movers vertical helps thousands of families relocate stress-free every month. - Handle on-ground escalations, damage complaints, and service issues with prompt resolution.
- Collect customer feedback and service completion confirmations post-move.
- Identify upsell opportunities for value-added services such as home cleaning, storage, and painting.

- Own bike + valid driving licence non-negotiable. The role requires daily field visits across the city.
- 0 - 3 years of experience in field sales, logistics coordination, or customer relationship management.

- Self-driven, punctual, and target-oriented with a problem-solving mindset.
- Comfortable using smartphone apps and basic CRM/Google Sheets for daily reporting.
- Graduates preferred; HSC with relevant field experience will also be considered.
- Local candidates with good knowledge of city geography will have an advantage.

What's in It for You:
- Fixed salary + attractive performance-based incentives on every completed move.

- Health insurance up to 1 lakh.
- Fast-track growth into senior FRM, Team Lead, or Operations roles.
- Structured onboarding and training from day one.

Description:
Company: NoBroker Interiors
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Employment Type: Internship / Full-Time
Experience: Freshers / 02 Years
Department: Human Resources Talent Acquisition
Working Days: Monday to Saturday
Work Mode: Work from Office

About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-driven real estate platform focused on simplifying property transactions and related services. We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated individuals to join our Talent Acquisition team and help us build high-performing teams across the organization.

Job Summary
We are looking for energetic, proactive, and result-oriented individuals to join our Talent Acquisition team at NoBroker in Bengaluru. The role involves managing end-to-end recruitment activities, sourcing candidates, screening resumes, coordinating interviews, and ensuring a smooth candidate experience.

This opportunity is ideal for freshers, recent graduates, and aspiring HR professionals who want to gain hands-on experience in recruitment and talent management.

Key Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end recruitment activities for assigned positions across departments.
Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
Conduct initial telephonic screenings to assess candidate suitability, communication skills, and interest.
Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process and maintain regular communication.
Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and daily hiring reports.
Work closely with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and hiring priorities.
Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Support the team in achieving recruitment targets and turnaround times.

Required Skills and Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in any discipline; HR or management graduates are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply for internship and full-time opportunities.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Comfortable making calls and interacting with candidates.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, and email communication.
Strong interpersonal skills, confidence, and a positive attitude.
Ability to multitask, prioritize work, and meet deadlines.
Willingness to learn recruitment processes and work in a fast-paced environment.
Prior recruitment or HR internship experience is an added advantage.

Who Can Apply?
Fresh graduates looking to start their careers in Human Resources.
Candidates interested in Talent Acquisition and recruitment.
Individuals seeking hands-on recruitment experience through an internship.
Candidates with prior recruitment experience who are looking for a full-time opportunity.

What We Offer
Hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment.
Exposure to multiple hiring requirements and recruitment channels.
Opportunity to learn sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and candidate management.
A collaborative and fast-paced work environment.
Opportunity to build a career in Human Resources and Talent Acquisition.

Work Schedule: Monday to Saturday
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Work Mode: Work from Office
Interested candidates can apply with their updated resumes.

Company Description
NoBroker.com, India's first Proptech unicorn, is a revolutionary brokerage-free property search portal that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating intermediaries. Founded in 2014 by IIT and IIM alumni, NoBroker.com serves over 3 million users monthly across major cities like Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, and more. Backed by prominent global investors, the organization has raised $366 million, fueling its mission of creating a seamless and transparent real estate experience. With a passionate team of 2000+ employees, NoBroker.com offers brokerage-free property solutions, rental agreements, home service support, and a suite of additional services designed to make real estate transactions efficient and user-friendly.

Role Description
The Customer Relationship Manager (freshers role) will be part of the sales team, assisting customers through detailed interaction and ensuring exemplary service delivery. Responsibilities include building and maintaining relationships with customers, guiding them through their property leasing or buying journey, and ensuring their requirements are met efficiently. Additional duties involve resolving queries, providing product/service insights, and collaborating internally to align customer needs. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Bengaluru Area.
Qualifications
Strong communication, active listening, and interpersonal skills
Customer-oriented mindset with a problem-solving attitude
Proficiency in time management and organizational abilities
Basic knowledge of MS Office and CRM tools is advantageous
Ability to work effectively independently and in a team
Fresh graduates with enthusiasm for sales and customer engagement are encouraged to apply
Fluency in English and proficiency in additional regional languages is a plus
Industry
Real Estate

Description:
We are looking for customer-focused and detail-oriented Non Voice Process as Customer Support Advisors to join the our client at Vizag Location. The role involves assisting US customers queries, service requests, transactions and general support.
The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, strong problem-solving ability and the confidence to handle customer interactions in a fast-paced international environment.
Key Responsibilities
Handle customer queries through chat and/or non-voice channels and Voice depending on business requirements.
Assist customers with rider and driver account-related concerns.
Resolve customer issues related to local transportation services.
Handle account access, verification and security-related queries.
Provide accurate information regarding services, bookings and account-related requests.
Investigate customer concerns and provide appropriate resolutions within defined guidelines.
Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction during every interaction.
Document customer interactions accurately in CRM/internal systems.
Follow standard operating procedures, quality guidelines and process policies.
Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate support team.
Protect customer information and maintain confidentiality.
Meet defined performance metrics such as CSAT, AHT, productivity, quality and resolution targets.
Maintain professional communication and demonstrate empathy while handling customers.
Adapt to process updates, new tools and changing business requirements.
Candidate Requirements
Graduate in any discipline preferred.
Freshers may be considered depending on the hiring requirement.
Experience in BPO, Customer Service, International Voice, Chat or Non-Voice is an advantage.
Excellent English communication skills.
Good typing and written communication skills for non-voice/chat roles.
Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities.
Comfortable working in rotational and night shifts.
Basic knowledge of computers, MS Office and CRM applications.
Willingness to work from office as per business requirements.
Eligibility
Education: 10+2
Experience: Freshers - 4 Years
CTC: LPA 1.8 2.8 LPA
(Based on previous CTC and applicable hike, up to 30%. Max 2.8)
Work Details
Work Location: Work From Office
Working Days: 5 Days Working
Week Off: 2 Rotational Week Offs
Cab Facility: Two-Side Cab
Documents Required
Candidates should have the following documents available:
Education Documents
Aadhaar Card
PAN Card
Educational Certificates / Marks Memos
Previous Employment Documents
Offer Letter
Previous Organization Pay Slips
Relieving / Experience Letter
Interview Process
1. HR Round
2. AMCAT
3. Versant
4. Operations Round

Description:
Job Description
We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically sound Technical Manager to join our property valuation team. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating property inspections, assessing property details, reviewing technical documentation, preparing valuation reports, and ensuring accuracy and quality in valuation-related activities.
The ideal candidate should have a background in Civil Engineering, good analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate with clients, field executives, and internal teams to ensure timely completion of assignments.

Roles and Responsibilities
Coordinate and manage property valuation assignments for residential, commercial, and other real estate properties.
Conduct property site inspections to assess construction quality, property condition, measurements, and specifications.
Verify property documents, approved building plans, layouts, and other technical records.
Assess construction costs, property dimensions, built-up areas, and other relevant technical parameters.
Prepare, review, and verify property valuation reports for accuracy and completeness.
Coordinate with field staff, clients, banks, financial institutions, and other stakeholders for property inspections and documentation.
Ensure timely completion and submission of valuation reports as per client requirements.
Identify discrepancies in property documents, site measurements, and technical details, and coordinate for their resolution.
Maintain proper records of site visits, photographs, inspection details, and valuation documentation.
Ensure compliance with company procedures, client guidelines, and applicable valuation standards.
Monitor the progress of assignments and follow up with the concerned teams to meet deadlines.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering is mandatory.
13 years of relevant experience in property valuation, civil engineering, construction, real estate, or a related field.
Basic understanding of building construction, estimation, measurements, and civil engineering drawings.
Knowledge of property inspection, valuation processes, and construction cost estimation is preferred.
Good analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and basic computer applications.
Good communication, coordination, and time-management skills.
Ability to travel for property site inspections, whenever required.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

Key Competencies: Technical knowledge | Property inspection | Report preparation | Team coordination | Documentation | Quality control
AboutCompany: We are a property valuation firm based out of FC road, Pune and Bandra, Mumbai. We deal with all banks and NBFCs.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Operations
Maintain accurate books of accounts, accounting entries, ledgers, and supporting documentation.
Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense tracking, and bank reconciliations.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
Prepare periodic financial statements, MIS reports, and expense summaries.
Monitor client invoices, collections, vendor payments, and outstanding balances.

2. Taxation & Statutory Compliances
Coordinate GST returns, TDS calculations, deductions, payments, and return filings.
Maintain statutory records and ensure timely completion of applicable regulatory compliances.
Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants, auditors, and statutory consultants.
Support preparation of documents for audits, assessments, and financial reviews.
Track statutory deadlines and maintain an organized compliance calendar.

3. Payroll & HR-Related Financial Administration
Support payroll processing, salary reconciliation, and employee reimbursement accounting.
Assist with applicable payroll-related statutory compliances, including PF, ESI, and professional tax, wherever applicable.
Maintain accurate employee-related financial records and documentation.
Coordinate with the HR team to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs and reconciliations.

4. Process Excellence & Business Support
Develop and maintain systematic accounting records, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
Identify opportunities to improve accounting accuracy, reporting efficiency, and compliance tracking.
Support budgeting, cost monitoring, cash-flow tracking, and financial planning activities.
Provide timely financial information to leadership for operational and business decisions.
Demonstrate ownership in building scalable processes as the organization grows.

Preferred candidate profile

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:
Strong fundamentals in accounting, taxation, and financial documentation.
Attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and a structured approach to work.
A strong sense of ownership, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.
The ability to manage deadlines and coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
A proactive mindset with the willingness to learn, improve processes, and take on greater responsibilities.
An interest in understanding the business beyond accounting entries and compliance checklists.
AboutCompany:
HiveStrat HR Consulting | Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Build Strong Foundations. Enable Growth. Shape the Future.

About HiveStrat HR Consulting

HiveStrat is a strategic HR consulting organization partnering with businesses to create meaningful impact through people strategy, organizational effectiveness, leadership development, performance management, and strategic talent solutions.

As we expand our consulting capabilities and strengthen our organizational foundation, we believe that robust financial discipline, statutory compliance, and operational excellence are essential enablers of sustainable growth.

We are looking for a committed, analytical, and growth-oriented professional to join us as Executive Accounts & Compliances and play an important role in strengthening our financial processes, compliance framework, and business operations.

Description:
We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Executive on behalf of our client. This is a remote role open to candidates based in Bangalore. You will own the hiring process from sourcing to offer, helping the client find and bring in the right talent. It's a great fit for someone who is people-oriented, organized, and enjoys the fast pace of recruitment.

Role & responsibilities
Handle end-to-end recruitment: understanding requirements, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing offers
Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Instahyre) and social media
Use Boolean search and talent databases to find active and passive candidates
Screen resumes, conduct initial HR rounds, and shortlist candidates
Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers and candidates
Work closely with hiring managers to understand role needs and hiring timelines
Maintain candidate data and hiring trackers in ATS or Excel
Follow up with candidates, manage offers, and ensure smooth onboarding
Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for future hiring needs
Track recruitment metrics (time-to-hire, offer acceptance rate) and share regular reports
Represent the employer brand positively during all candidate interactions

Preferred candidate profile
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred)
0 to 1 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition (internships count)
Good knowledge of the recruitment lifecycle and sourcing techniques
Familiarity with job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, and ATS tools
Strong communication and negotiation skills
Good organizational and time-management abilities
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setup
Comfortable with video interviews and online collaboration tools
Stable internet connection and own laptop

Description:
Job Title: Showroom Receptionist

Company: Homworks A Prominance Group Venture

Department: Front Office / Customer Experience

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 13 Years (Freshers with excellent communication and presentation skills may apply)

Shift Timing: 11:00 AM 8:00 PM

Working Days: Sunday is mandatory

Weekly Off: One day between Monday and Thursday

Industry: Home Interiors / Retail / Hospitality

Job Description

We are looking for a confident, well-groomed, and customer-oriented Showroom Receptionist to represent Homworks at our premium home interiors showroom. The candidate will be the first point of contact for walk-in customers, architects, designers, and business visitors, ensuring a professional and welcoming showroom experience.
The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, a pleasant personality, strong customer-handling abilities, and basic computer knowledge.

Key Responsibilities

Welcome and greet walk-in customers, architects, designers, and other visitors professionally.
Manage front-desk operations and maintain a neat, organised, and welcoming reception area.
Answer incoming calls, handle general enquiries, and direct calls to the appropriate departments.
Introduce customers to Homworks' home interior solutions and showroom offerings.
Coordinate with sales consultants, interior designers, and other relevant teams.
Maintain visitor registers, customer details, and CRM records accurately.
Manage incoming and outgoing couriers, documents, and dispatches.
Handle basic administrative activities, data entry, emails, and daily reports.
Ensure a positive customer experience and maintain professional showroom standards.

Skills & Requirements

1–3 years of experience in reception, front office, hospitality, customer service, or retail showroom operations.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and professional presentation are welcome.
Fluency in English, Hindi, and the relevant local language is mandatory.
Excellent verbal communication, interpersonal, and customer-handling skills.
Professional grooming, a pleasant personality, and a confident approach.
Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, email, and computer operations.
Good organisational skills and the ability to coordinate with multiple teams.
Willingness to work on Sundays and take one weekly off between Monday and Thursday.
Comfortable working the 11:00 AM–8:00 PM shift.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates from premium retail showrooms, hospitality, front office, customer service, or home interior businesses will be preferred.
Job Location: Chennai,Hyderabad,Bangalore
How to Apply: Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply with their updated resume.
AboutCompany:
Prominance is Indias largest manufacturer & supplier of energy efficient uPVC Windows & uPVC Doors. We source the finest grade of raw material from European Fortune 500 companies. The optimized production process outputs 100% lead-free & durable uPVC profiles for Indian climate. Our uPVC window and door systems subjected to 25000+ hours of extreme weather ensure excellence. We have received certifications from Global labs SKZ Germany. Prominance uPVC Window & Door Systems surpass European quality standards in all mechanical property tests.
We are one of the most trusted uPVC brands used by Real Estate Firms globally. Our wide range of uPVC Window & Door is available with coloured texture options including wood finishes.

Description:
Tele Calling Executive

Department: Sales & Customer Servicing
Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.28 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components and based on relevant experience)

About NoBroker

NoBroker.com is India's leading brokerage-free real estate platform, connecting property owners, buyers, and tenants directly without intermediaries. Founded in 2014, NoBroker has grown into a leading PropTech company with a strong presence across major Indian cities.
Role Overview
We are looking for Tele Calling Executives who can effectively communicate with customers, understand their requirements, provide relevant solutions, and contribute to sales and customer satisfaction. The role involves handling both inbound and outbound calls and may include customer servicing, relationship management, lead follow-ups, and sales conversion.

Key Responsibilities

Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 34 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer interaction process.
Understand customer requirements and provide suitable information, solutions, and assistance related to NoBroker's property and services.
Build strong customer relationships through effective communication, regular follow-ups, and timely resolution of queries.
For sales-related interactions, pitch relevant NoBroker services, negotiate effectively, and convert qualified leads into customers.
For customer-service interactions, act as a relationship manager for customers and ensure a smooth and satisfactory service experience.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, leads, follow-ups, and conversions using internal CRM and calling tools.
Adhere to company processes, quality standards, and customer-service guidelines.
Work towards individual and team performance goals and contribute to overall business objectives.
Ensure a positive customer experience through professional communication and effective problem-solving.

Perks & Benefits

Performance Incentives: Up to 20,00025,000 per month, depending on role and performance.
Health Insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Career Growth: Opportunity to progress to Assistant Manager roles based on performance and experience.
Promotions: Performance-based promotions, with regular performance reviews.
Rewards & Recognition: Monthly recognition for high-performing employees.
Team Engagement: Regular team activities, parties, and Annual Day celebrations.
Employee Referral Program: Referral incentives for successful hires.

Eligibility & Skill Requirements

Education: 10th, 12th, or Graduate candidates can apply.
Candidates should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant customer service, telecalling, sales, or relationship-management experience can apply.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer-oriented approach with good listening and problem-solving abilities.
For sales responsibilities, candidates should have good negotiation, persuasion, and target-oriented skills.
Basic proficiency in MS Office, CRM, and calling tools.
Languages: English is mandatory. Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Marathi will be an added advantage.
Candidates should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage.
Candidates should be available for immediate joining.
Age: 18 to 30 years.

Work Schedule

6-day working week
Saturday and Sunday are working days.
One rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in emergencies.

Why Join NoBroker?
Join a fast-growing PropTech company and gain experience across customer service, sales, relationship management, and real estate operations. The role offers performance-based incentives, structured career growth, employee recognition, and opportunities to take on greater responsibilities based on performance.

Nobroker is a full stack player in proptech space and offers end-to-end services catering each and every
real estate need of a customer. We recently attained Unicorn status by becoming the first prop tech player
in India to reach $1 billion valuation.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Build great partnership with business in terms of understanding the needs and delivering as per agreed SLAs

Strong understanding of recruitment best practices and trends
Good communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. The role involves wearing and showcasing jewellery collections, demonstrating their features, and interacting with online audiences in real-time. The ideal candidate should be confident, well-spoken, and have a passion for fashion, jewellery, and customer engagement.
  Primary Responsibilities
  Live Anchoring & Jewellery Demonstration:
Host Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions, presenting and explaining jewellery collections.
Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.
Provide detailed descriptions of gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including design, craftsmanship, weight, pricing, and customization options.
Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.
Engage with viewers, encouraging them to interact, comment, and share.
Maintain high energy levels and professional on-screen presence.
Customer Engagement & Query Handling:
Respond to customer queries, comments, and messages during and after live sessions.
Share updates on ongoing offers, collections, and new arrivals.
Maintain a friendly and persuasive tone to encourage sales and brand loyalty.
Content Creation & Social Media Growth:
Plan and coordinate live session schedules to maximize reach and engagement.
Collaborate with the social media team to strategize content and themes for Live sessions.
Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.
Key Skills & Requirements: Educational Qualification Graduation in Mass Communication, Marketing, Fashion, or any relevant field. Experience 1-3 years in anchoring, live streaming, or social media hosting (jewellery or fashion industry preferred). Skills Required
Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and YouTube Live management.
Location Agartala, Tripura
Join Us & Be the Digital Face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers!

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role:
Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1.Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2.Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3.Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4.Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5.Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6.Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7.Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 TSMs & 200+ indirect employees.

Must Have: Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory

Why join us
A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals.
Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

About

Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Limited (BCIBL) is an IRDAI-licensed insurance broker and part of the Bajaj Capital Group. Position title: Sales Executive
Salary: 15k to 22K+ Huge Performance Incentive
Type of Job: Inhouse Sales

Job purpose
To achieve assigned sales targets by identifying potential customers, building strong relationships, and providing multiple financial products. The role involves ensuring customer satisfaction, driving persistency,
client meetings,need analysis,plan preparation,solution providing, collaborating with other teams and adhering to sales process guidelines to contribute to the overall profitability of the venue.

Key responsibilities

Sales & Business Development
Identify and approach prospective clients through direct sales, referrals and leads generated through market survey.
Analyze customer needs and recommend suitable financial products to achieve their financial goals.
Pitch & promote various financial products such as Life Insurance, Health Insurance, Mutual Funds.
Meets or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers to encourage repeat and referral business.
Provide ongoing support and after sales services to ensure customer satisfaction.
Handle customer queries, concerns and complaints promptly and professionally.

Driving Persistency
Ensure timely premium payments and policy renewals by engaging with customers and providing reminders or support.
Proactively address customer queries or concerns to reduce policy lapses.
Coordinate with customers to collect the relevant documents for policy renewals.

Market Intelligence & Product Knowledge
Stay updated on market trends in the insurance and mutual funds industry.
Maintain in depth knowledge of product features, benefits and compliance requirements.
Attend regular training sessions to enhance product knowledge, selling skills and compliance understanding.

Compliance & Documentation
Ensure adherence to regulatory and organizational guidelines during the sales process.
Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, sales transactions and financial advice provided.
Get Certified for required profile

Job Requirements

Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in any discipline

Experience: 0-3 years of experience

Functional and Behavioral requirements
Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand financial products and explain them effectively to clients.
Self-motivated with a result-oriented approach.

The platform enables companies to build relevant candidate pipelines, automate telephonic and WhatsApp outreach, screen resumes against role-specific requirements, conduct skill assessments with AI-based proctoring, and run conversational AI interviews with adaptive follow-up questions. Xquizit also provides detailed, evidence-backed candidate reports and consolidated evaluation insights to support faster and more consistent hiring decisions.
Designed as a modular platform, Xquizit can be used across individual stages of the hiring process or as an integrated sourcing-to-evaluation workflow, helping organizations reduce manual effort, improve hiring speed, and evaluate candidates more effectively at scale.

Description:
URGENT HIRING - CONSULTANT ANAESTHESIOLOGIST
Location: Kailashahar, Unakoti District, Tripura
Hospital Type: Multi-Speciality Hospital
Contact 639865 2832
POSITION
Consultant Anaesthesiologist - OT ICU
QUALIFICATION
- MD Anaesthesiology
- DNB Anaesthesiology
- DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia)
- Valid NMC / Tripura State Medical Council Registration
EXPERIENCE
- Experienced candidates preferred
- Candidates with hands-on OT and ICU experience will be given preference
SALARY
3 Lakhs - 3.5 Lakhs per Month
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct pre-operative anaesthesia assessment and evaluate surgical fitness
- Administer general, regional and other appropriate anaesthesia techniques
- Provide anaesthesia support for elective and emergency surgeries
- Monitor patients throughout surgical procedures and ensure safe peri-operative care
- Manage airway and intubation, including emergency airway situations
- Provide post-operative pain management and recovery care
- Support ICU management of critically ill patients in coordination with the treating team
- Assist with ventilator management and hemodynamic stabilization as required
- Respond to OT, ICU and hospital emergencies
- Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, OT staff and nursing teams
- Maintain accurate anaesthesia records and clinical documentation
- Follow infection-control, patient-safety and hospital protocols
SKILLS REQUIRED
- Strong clinical knowledge of Anaesthesia and peri-operative care
- Good airway management and emergency response skills
- OT and ICU experience preferred
- Knowledge of ventilator and critical care management
- Good clinical decision-making and teamwork skills
- Professional and patient-centric approach
JOB TYPE
- Full-Time Consultant
- OT ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity
Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with current salary, expected salary, notice period and relevant OT/ICU experience.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Description:
We are looking for an Assistant Project Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations and management of the Mobile Medical Unit (MMU) project. The candidate will coordinate with medical teams, field staff, drivers, and management to ensure smooth project operations and timely completion of project activities.

Key Responsibilities-


Coordinate and monitor the day-to-day operations of Mobile Medical Units (MMUs).
Coordinate with Doctors, Nurses, Pharmacists, Drivers, and other field staff.
Monitor staff attendance, duty schedules, leave, and field deployment.
Track daily MMU visits, patient services, medical camps, and other project activities.
Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
Coordinate with government officials, project authorities, and other stakeholders.
Ensure timely submission of project reports, attendance records, and other required documents.
Monitor MMU vehicle availability, maintenance, breakdowns, fuel, and related operational issues.
Follow up with field teams regarding pending activities and operational issues.
Ensure compliance with project guidelines, SOPs, and government/client requirements.
Identify operational issues and escalate them to the Project Manager/concerned authority.
Support inspections, audits, meetings, and field visits conducted by the client/government authorities.
Coordinate with HR, Admin, and Accounts teams regarding employee and project-related requirements.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Project Manager/management.


Required Skills & Qualifications-


Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PG qualification will be an added advantage.
24 years of relevant experience in project coordination, healthcare operations, MMU/ambulance operations, government projects, or a similar field.
Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and MIS reporting.
Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
Good team management and organizational abilities.
Ability to coordinate with field teams and government/client representatives.
Strong problem-solving and time-management skills.
Willingness to travel for field visits as required.
Candidates with experience in MMU, 108 Ambulance, healthcare, emergency services, or government projects will be preferred.
AboutCompany:
Jai Ambey Emergency Services (I) Private Limited (JAES) was founded about a decade ago and subsequently is incorporated on the 11th of June 2015 under the companies act of 2013 to provide, maintain, hire, undertake, and run emergency services.

1. Position Details
Designation: Sales Officer
Location: South Tripura
Department: Trade Sales
Reporting To: ASM/TSM
Salary Range: As per market standards
Experience: 23 years in Sales / Channel Management
Qualification: Graduation (MBA / Marketing preferred)
2. Role Purpose
The Executive – Sales is responsible for driving business growth in the territory by managing dealer and sub-dealer networks, achieving sales and collection targets, strengthening market presence, and ensuring effective execution of company strategies.
3. Key Deliverables / Responsibilities
Manage and expand channel distribution
Appoint, develop, and monitor dealers and authorized sub-dealers
Achieve assigned primary and secondary sales targets
Ensure availability of products and correct market pricing
Execute brand-building and promotional activities at local level
Conduct mason/contractor meets and provide technical support
Ensure timely collection and healthy fund flow from dealers
Track competitor activity and provide market intelligence
Maintain accurate sales reports, MIS, and forecasts
4. Key Result Areas (KRA) & Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
KRA 1: Sales Target Achievement
Monthly, quarterly, and annual volume & value target achievement
Growth in secondary sales and repeat business
KRA 2: Channel Development
Appointment of new dealers and sub-dealers
Improvement in dealer productivity and coverage
KRA 3: Market Development & Visibility
Increased market share in Sivasagar region
Execution of branding, visibility, and promotional activities
KRA 4: Collection & Credit Control
Timely collection as per credit norms
Reduction of overdue and outstanding balances
KRA 5: Compliance & Reporting
Adherence to company pricing, schemes, and SOPs
Timely reporting of sales, collections, and market feedback
5. Roadmap of Success
0–3 Months
Understand company products, pricing, and sales processes
Map Sivasagar market, dealer base, and competitor landscape
Build strong relationships with dealers and influencers
3–6 Months
Achieve minimum 85–90% of assigned sales targets
Expand sub-dealer network in uncovered areas
Improve product visibility and secondary sales
6–12 Months
Consistently achieve or exceed targets
Strengthen dealer loyalty and market share
Become a key contributor to regional business growth

AboutCompany:
About the company

As India's largest insurance broker, Policy bazaar is committed to making insurance accessible and understandable
for every Indian. Since 2008, we have been at the forefront of transforming the insurance sector by providing
transparent, efficient, and unbiased solutions tailored to the diverse needs of over 80.5 million registered users.
With a dominant market share of over 93% in the digital insurance aggregator space and annual premium
collection exceeding 15,000 crore in FY24, we have established ourselves as a trusted name in insurance and
financial protection. Our platform facilitates millions of insurance inquiries annually and features a wide range of
products from over 50 insurance partners, covering health, life, motor, and corporate insurance solutions.
To date, we have issued over 44.3 million policies and played a crucial role in protecting 9 million families against
death, disease, and disability. Our 24x7 online support, combined with on-ground assistance from over 6,000
insurance advisors, ensures a seamless experience for our customers.
With an average customer rating of 4.4 stars and more than 23 million app downloads, we are dedicated to
fulfilling the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of Indias (IRDAI) vision of "Har Family Hogi Insured
by 2047." Whether it is policy issuance, claim settlement, or simply understanding your insurance needs better, we
are here to help.
Join us on our mission to make insurance simple, accessible, and effective for all.

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.


Required Skills
Academic Counselling
Admission Guidance
Admission Counselling

Language Skills
Good communication skills in English are required.
Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.
Agartala
This is a Full-Time, Office-Based position .

Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Renewable Energy Engineer to support the Department of Energy, Government of Chhattisgarh/Tripura in monitoring and implementing key renewable energy programs, including PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY) and PM-KUSUM.

Location: Raipur, Chhattisgarh/Agartala, Tripura (Full-time deployment with Department of Energy, Government of Chhattisgarh)

Assignment Duration: 12 Months(Contingent upon Winning the bid)

Engagement Type: Consultant / Fixed-Term Project Assignment
Key Responsibilities
Support monitoring and implementation of renewable energy projects and government schemes.
Work closely with the Department of Energy, CSPDCL, and CREDA.
Assist in project tracking, reporting, stakeholder coordination, and data analysis.
Support training and capacity-building initiatives for government officials.
Prepare presentations, reports, and project updates.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Master's degree in Engineering, MBA, or related field preferred.

Experience
Minimum 2 years of experience in the renewable energy sector in India.
Experience supporting at least one renewable energy project with a state utility, government department, or renewable energy agency.
Exposure to project monitoring, implementation, or advisory assignments.

Skills
Good understanding of renewable energy projects and government programs.
Strong analytical, coordination, and communication skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Excellent written and spoken English.
