Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Accounts & Auditing:
Designing and implementing systems to ensure smooth functioning of finance & accounting operations across the organization.
Supervising the preparation of MIS reports to provide feedback to top management on financial performance, viz, fund management, variance analysis, profitability, etc
Budgeting / System Implementation & MIS.
Formulating budgets and conducting variance analysis to determine difference between projected & actual results and implementing corrective actions.
Handling working capital management and dealing with banks on day-to-day basis.
Coordinating with internal & statutory auditors; evaluating internal control systems / procedures to highlight the shortcomings and implementing necessary recommendations.
Supervising Purchase Invoice booking, GRNs, Service invoices of Freight and Capex and Engineering bills.
Costing
Determining the manufacturing cost and MRP of the product; compiling cost and performance reports, cost benefits analysis and critical analysis of cost reports
Preparing cost sheets of the products manufactured, variance analysis and giving total costing to Marketing Department as and when required.
Maintaining all cost accounting record rule as per statutory requirements and conducting cost audit of the products covered under 'Chemicals.
Cost saving measures.
Dealing with Plant & Machinery related Issues
Scrap Monitoring and negotiation through E-Auction Process
Negotiation and arrangement of Transport Service Providers leveraging E-Auction
Taxation & Statutory Compliances:
Preparing tax plans and ensuring timely payments and filing of direct & indirect tax returns in compliance with statutory tax acts.
Liasoning with government departments and regulatory authorities for obtaining necessary sanctions and ensuring compliance with various statutory obligations.
Filling of periodical GST returns, handling GST audit / assessments, periodical reconciliation of ITC claimed by the units with counter party GST returns.
In depth knowledge of Central and State Industrial Policy, preparing periodical incentive application, obtaining certificate, and ensuring disbursement

Preferred candidate profile
10 years experience. Candidate should have extensive experience of handling Accounts & Finance in a factory environment preferably in Greenfield projects
AboutCompany: Berger Paints India Limited (BPIL) is one of India's foremost paint companies, currently ranked as second largest on the basis of consolidated sales turnover in Indian paint industry.

Description:
To ensure implementation of safe work practices and technology, analyse and mitigate risks with respect to health and safety, ensure statutory compliance related to safety and control pollution in the manufacturing unit.
Principal Accountabilities:
Ensure through regular rounds/ proper liaising with workmen & staff for compliance of safe work practices.
Ensure that proper records as per the guidelines of Corporate Safety are maintained.
To plan training of all contractors and own employees for safety and ensure implementation.
To ensure that all incidents are captured and analyzed and actions are planned and taken to prevent recurrence.
To ensure that best safe work practices are identified and implemented.
To ensure formal reports/reviews of action plans of EHS audit and regular follow up on internal audits.
To ensure that regular EHS audits are carried out and also external audits are coordinated and organized.
Plan and ensure that EHS Committee Meetings are held regularly.
Ensure risk assessment / hazard spotting exercises are carried out on regular basis.
To make sure that safety features are in-built at the initial stage of new projects and inspect / recommend rectification of any unsafe guarding / inter-locking of new machines before they are commissioned on the floor.
Recommend and advise the Management the impacts of various environment pollution parameters and suggest ways & means of controlling the same.
Knowledge:
Safe work practices and technology, such as, categories of guarding, etc. of machines.
In depth knowledge of statutory compliance in relation to occupational health, safety and environment, fire and life safety
Understanding of ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 standards on EHS
Various acts of Laws, such as, Factories Act, Labor Laws, Employee Compensation Act, etc

Description:
Job Summary:We are looking for a dynamic and result-driven Sales Executive to join our team in the paint industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, meeting sales targets, developing new customer relationships, and ensuring customer satisfaction in their designated territory.

Key Responsibilities:
Promote and sell a wide range of decorative and industrial paints to dealers, contractors, architects, and end-users.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, and key clients.
Conduct regular market visits to identify business opportunities and gather market intelligence.
Ensure timely order booking, payment collection, and inventory management at dealer/distributor points.
Achieve monthly and annual sales targets as assigned.
Organise product demonstrations, on-site sampling, and training sessions for clients.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales, and follow-up actions using CRM or sales reporting tools.
Provide after-sales support and ensure customer satisfaction.

Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Knowledge of the local market and dealer/distributor network.
Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Self-motivated and target-oriented.

We offer a comprehensive range of decorative and industrial paints, including emulsions, enamels, distempers, primers, and specialty coatings. Our products are known for innovation, quality, and durability, catering to residential, commercial, and industrial segments.

Legacy of trust and quality
Strong backing of Berger Paints

Description:
Immediate hiring for Electric Vehicle Sales

Interview Mode : F2F Only

Experience Required:-
0-2 years of experience in Commercial Vehicle (CV) sales and/or Automobile Dealership Sales.
Candidates from commercial vehicle, passenger vehicle, two-wheeler, EV dealership, and automobile retail sales backgrounds can be considered.
Compensation:-
Net Salary: 18,000 - 22,000 per month
Sales Incentive: 2,500 per vehicle sale
Budget flexibility up to 25,000 - 30,000 for strong and relevant performers, along with the applicable incentive structure.

Key Responsibilities:-
Generate and convert sales leads.
Handle dealership walk-in customers and field sales activities.
Conduct product demonstrations and test drives.
Achieve monthly vehicle sales targets.
Understand customer requirements, provide vehicle recommendations, resolve queries, and maintain long-term relationships.
Maintain customer relationships and generate referral business.
Coordinate with finance and documentation teams for seamless vehicle delivery.
Ideal Candidate:-
Candidates from commercial vehicle, passenger vehicle, two-wheeler, EV dealership, and automobile retail sales backgrounds can be considered.
Good in Sales & Negotiation, Communication, Customer Service, Relationship Management, Lead Generation, Target Achievement.
Who can handle Vehicle Sales Target, Lead Conversion Ratio, Customer Satisfaction Score, Finance Penetration, Insurance Attachment, Referral Business.
Support vehicle booking, registration, loan processing, insurance, and delivery documentation.
Energetic, customer-focused sales professional with strong communication skills and a proven ability to meet sales targets.
Good verbal communication in local language & English
Excellent presentation and relationship-building skills
Willingness to travel locally for customer meetings and field activities

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Director Fund Raising And CSR (Philanthropy)
Responsible for cultivating relationships with donors, planning and executing fundraising campaigns and events, researching prospective donors, writing grant proposals, managing donor databases, and tracking financial goals to secure financial support for a non-profit's mission. Responsibilities include strategic planning, communication, donor stewardship, budget management, and reporting on fundraising progress to ensure organizational sustainability and growth.
Key Responsibilities>:
Donor Cultivation & Stewardship: Developing and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with individual, corporate, and foundation donors to secure ongoing financial support.
Campaign & Event Management: Planning, organizing, and executing fundraising campaigns and events, including community-led initiatives and major donor cultivation events.
Prospect Research: Identifying and researching potential donors, sponsors, and grant-making foundations interested in supporting the organization's mission.
Proposal & Grant Writing: Researching opportunities and writing persuasive grant applications and fundraising proposals to secure financial contributions.
Database & Financial Management: Creating and maintaining accurate donor databases, tracking donations, preparing financial reports, and managing budgets to meet fundraising goals.
Communication & Marketing: Creating fundraising materials, such as presentations, brochures, and thank-you letters, to effectively communicate the organization's mission and needs.
Fund Raising
Identify and cultivate relationships with potential donors, sponsors, and investors.
Create and implement fundraising campaigns and initiatives.
Develop compelling fundraising proposals and presentations.
Manage and maintain donor databases and records.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align fundraising efforts with our mission
and objectives.
Monitor and report on fundraising progress and results.
Qualifications & Experience:
1. A bachelor's degree in fields like Social Work, Nonprofit Management, or a related area is often preferred and experience of 10 Plus Years in fundraising, event planning, nonprofit work, volunteers, and community members etc.
2. The ability to develop and implement successful fundraising strategies that align with organizational goals.
3. Proven track record of successful fundraising efforts, with a focus on raising immediate funds.
4. Organizational: Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple projects and events simultaneously.
5. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including writing, editing, and public speaking.
6. Strong abilities to build and nurture relationships with diverse groups of people, including donors,
Career Focus
1. Fundraising in philanthropy is a people-focused role that requires strong empathy and communication to understand what inspires potential donors and to articulate the benefits of their support.
2. The job involves a significant focus on people and community, requiring the ability to effectively engage and inspire supporters for the cause.

iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills

Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Experience-4-12 years
Location- Hyderabad/Bangalore/Delhi

Design and implement scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective cloud architectures on AWS.
Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives, including application re-platforming, re-hosting, and cloud-native transformations.
Develop solution architectures aligned with business objectives, security standards, and operational requirements.
Build and automate cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and AWS CDK.
Design and deploy containerized applications using Docker, Amazon ECS, and Amazon EKS.
Develop and implement serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and Step Functions.
Configure and manage core AWS services including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, WAF, and Amazon Bedrock.
Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure successful cloud adoption and governance.
Optimize cloud environments for performance, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
Provide technical leadership and guidance during client engagements, workshops, and solution discussions.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex cloud infrastructure and application issues.
Required Skills & Qualifications
AWS Cloud Expertise
Strong hands-on experience with AWS core services:
Amazon EC2
Amazon S3
Amazon VPC
AWS IAM
Amazon RDS
AWS WAF
Amazon Bedrock
Solution Architecture
Proven experience designing enterprise-scale cloud architectures and solutions.
Strong understanding of AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud best practices.
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Description:
JD - Beat Trainer
Location Bangalore, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Delhi
Job description
This will include but is not limited to:
To prepare Training Calendars/PJP and get business sign offs
To conduct Sales training as well as On the Job coaching on Telecom products, processes sales
To ensure effective and high quality training delivery
To conduct in-depth evaluation of the impact of the training programs
Provide feedback to trainees as well as provide support coach them as and when required
To attend zonal reviews and present reports
To ensure 100% compliance in preparation of reports and other internal processes
Essential Qualifications
Candidate must be minimum a Graduate with overall 8 years of experience in Sales/ Sales Training preferably in telecom domain.
Candidate must have an experience in sales for 2 years minimum.
Candidate must have at least 5 years of experience in telecom sales training and must have understanding of Internet Leased lines/Broadband/Postpaid Data service provider products
Candidate with Enterprise SalestTraining experience in Telecom industry will be considered
Candidate with Broad band experience will be preferred

Job Description: iOS Developer
Job Title: iOS Developer
Experience: 5to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to design, develop, and maintain high-quality iOS applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Swift, iOS SDK, and mobile application development with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and UIKit/SwiftUI.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party libraries/services.
Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and security.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following coding standards.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Ensure applications comply with Apple's App Store guidelines.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Swift.
Expertise in iOS SDK, UIKit, and/or SwiftUI.
, Interface Builder, and iOS development tools.
Good understanding of MVC, MVVM, VIPER architecture patterns.
Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks.
Knowledge of Core Data, SQLite, UserDefaults, and data persistence.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems.
Understanding of mobile security, memory management, and performance optimization.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Push Notifications).
Knowledge of XCTest, Unit Testing, and UI Testing.
Experience with CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, or Carthage.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Published applications on the Apple App Store.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Nice to Have
Experience working in Agile environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Keywords: Swift, Objective-C, iOS SDK, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, REST API, Core Data, Firebase, MVVM, Mobile App Development, Git, XCTest, App Store Deployment.

Job Title - Instructional Design - Analyst - TO- (SC GN)
Management Level: 11 - Analyst
Location: Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai
Must have skills: Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline
Good to have skills: Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model
Job Summary:
As a Talent Organization (TO) professional in the SC Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process.Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles Responsibilities:

Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our TO practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.

Professional Technical Skills:
Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience: 2-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning
Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.



Qualification
Experience: Minimum 2-3 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification: Any Bachelors Fulltime

Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

Mandatory Skills
SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

Good to Have
SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Position Summary
The Cybersecurity Software Lead will join our Software organization to design and implement the cybersecurity features our In Flight Entertainment and Connectivity (IFEC) product suite. The candidate must be a proficient technical leader and have extensive knowledge of cybersecurity of software systems that utilize Android and/or Linux platforms, multi-layered, client-server technologies. Experience in developing complex Java and C/C++ applications on the Android and Linux platform is required. Experience in following cybersecurity features is required: Firewall, Antivirus, Key management, Encryption, SELinux. Candidate must also possess excellent communication skills that will help in the job of leading, and facilitating discussions between stakeholders. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist also has software development responsibilities for prototyping new features. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will work with SW Architects, SW development teams and system teams.
Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will provide his technical expertise, guidance, oversight and drive the following:
Drive software architecture Cybersecurity aspects for the IFEC product lines Lead the design of the Cybersecurity features Responsible for Writing the Cybersecurity use cases (user stories), and allocate them to the functional components as necessary Lead the definition of interfaces/APIs between software components Provide the technical expertise and communicate on cybersecurity effectively to other engineers and management via presentations, architecture documents/diagrams, and software requirements Select COTS (Commercial Off the Shelf) and OSS (Open Source Software) for cybersecurity features Assess vulnerabilities of existing COTS and OSS and propose needed updates Analyze existing designs, define and implement security improvements to the existing IFEC designs Must be able to create proof-of-concepts as necessary to demonstrate new ideas/technologies and architectural concepts Participate in detailed design and code reviews for compliance with the defined secured software architecture Ensure the software implementation is in line with the proposed software architecture and recommended design patterns Partner Product and Program Management teams to define and estimate the work scope of new projects and cybersecurity features Responsible for providing technical leadership to junior software engineers in the areas of software design and implementation
Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language
Required Education and Experience:
Area of study: Computer Science
Master degree in field with minimum 6 years of experience
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
OR
Bachelor degree in field with minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in IFE
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
Skills:
Expertise in cybersecurity features like Firewall, certificates/key/authentication management, SELinux, Antivirus
Fluent in Java, C, C++, shell scripting, networking protocols, audio video distribution, and database management
Expertise in Android Framework/Internals
Experience with the Linux operating system and SELinux
Experience in software design and development of Android and/or Linux-based systems following an industrial process
Knowledge of the Scrum development process and Continuous Integration practices and tools (e.g. Jenkins, Sonar, GIT, BitBucket, JIRA)
Very good knowledge of all phases of software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, design, implementation, code review, testing, and release
Self-motivated, critical thinker with strong technical background
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience with IFEC systems is a plus
Preferred Qualifications
Master degree in Computer Science
Physical Demands
At Thales, we re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Description:
Join our Team
About This Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Software Developer - BMC Helix to join our team and take ownership of the development, integration deployment of BMC Remedy/Helix ITSM applications in enterprise environments. In this role, you will work across the full application lifecycle - from design and development to integration and support - ensuring the platform is aligned with business processes and ITIL best practices. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable ITSM solutions.

What You Will Do

- Develop, configure, and customize BMC Remedy AR System (ARS 8.0+) and BMC Remedy ITSM Suite modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, SRM, SLM, and Knowledge Management
- Manage Foundation Data - including creation, updates, and deletion - and configure ITSM components end-to-end
- Administer Remedy Server and Mid-Tier - covering AR Server, Approval Server, Email Engine, Reporting, and Audit Logging configuration
- Perform installation, upgrades, feature design, development, and data loads for BMC Remedy/Helix applications
- Build and maintain integrations with third-party and B2B systems; lead migrations and consolidation of disparate systems into an enterprise ITSM infrastructure
- Provide technical support across the Remedy Suite - including ADDM, BCM, CMDB, and Asset Management - across production, test, and development environments
- Manage Change Management approvals, assignments, notification mechanisms, SLM, and end-to-end CM lifecycle
- Perform bug fixes, workflow enhancements, and troubleshoot applications at workflow and database levels
- Translate business requirements into application designs using best-practice technical solutions; create and maintain design specifications and architectural diagrams
- Support all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

What You Will Bring

- 2- 7 years hands-on development experience with BMC Remedy AR System and BMC/Helix ITSM applications
- Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL
- Strong understanding of third-party and B2B integration architecture with Remedy
- Experience with enterprise migrations and consolidation of ITSM platforms
- Ability to create and maintain architectural diagrams, design specifications, and process documentation
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- End-to-end architecture visibility with the ability to understand application, integration, and infrastructure dependencies
- Demonstrated ownership and accountability in delivering solutions and resolving issues
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, thats why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Management Level: 6 Senior Manager
Location: Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Good to have skills: Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Job Summary:
As a Talent Organization (TO) professional in the SC Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process.Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles Responsibilities:

Lead learning efforts for large-scale as well as niche business transformation programs.
Develop learning strategies that are aligned with clients business and talent strategies, driving positive change, innovation, and development across the client organization.

Supervise the learning development team on projects; be the primary point of contact for external and internal stakeholders for program scope, budget, timelines, progress, risks, escalations, and updates; monitor effectiveness of learning programs; and recommend new approaches to enhance learning solution offered.

Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting

Proven team working and change management skills
Mind set of continuous improvement and aiming for excellence

Description:
Role: Workday Financials Delivery Manager
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.
Provide functional oversight across areas such as general accounting, journals, close, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, payments and settlements.
Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.
Review solution designs and functional deliverables to ensure quality, scalability and alignment with Workday leading practices.
Coordinate across Financials, Integrations, Reporting, Security and other dependent workstreams to resolve issues and manage end-to-end impacts.
Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.
Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled PLM Teamcenter Support Engineer with 3-8 years of relevant experience in PLM, Teamcenter Support, ITK, BMIDE, and Active Workspace (AWC) Customization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for supporting, configuring, customizing, and maintaining Teamcenter environments while collaborating with business users, development teams, and stakeholders to ensure smooth PLM operations.
Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 support for Siemens Teamcenter PLM applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve Teamcenter production issues and user-reported incidents.
Develop and maintain customizations using ITK (Integration Toolkit).
Configure and customize Teamcenter using BMIDE (Business Modeler IDE).
Perform Active Workspace (AWC) Customization and enhancements.
Develop workflows, handlers, business rules, and validations in Teamcenter.
Support Teamcenter upgrades, patches, deployments, and migrations.
Analyze business requirements and implement PLM solutions.
Monitor application performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with business users, product engineering teams, and IT stakeholders.
Create technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in incident, problem, and change management activities.
Required Skills
3-8 years of experience in PLM Teamcenter Support.
Strong experience in Siemens Teamcenter.
Hands-on experience in ITK Development.
Expertise in BMIDE Customization and Configuration.
Experience with Active Workspace (AWC) Customization.
Knowledge of Teamcenter Architecture and Data Model.
Experience in Workflow Development and Customization.
Understanding of Teamcenter Access Manager and Security.
Experience in Teamcenter deployment and support activities.
Strong SQL and database knowledge.
Experience with Unix/Linux and Windows environments.
Good debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter SOA and Web Services.
Teamcenter RAC Customization.
Java and JavaScript development experience.
Teamcenter Integration with CAD tools (NX, CATIA, Creo, SolidWorks).
Knowledge of T4S/T4EA integrations.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Experience with Jenkins, Git, and DevOps practices.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
The Manager, Product Training, will be responsible for creating, executing and ongoing development of training curricula and learning content across the assigned proprietary product applications within WPP Open. They will ensure all hands-on users of the applications are well-equipped to utilize our products to their full potential, leading to increased adoption.
The role will report to the Director, Product Training and will work in partnership with Product Owners, Product Enablement and other functions across Data Technology Solutions.
WHAT WILL YOU DO
Collaborate with SMEs to ensure a deep understanding of product functionality, features, and benefits.
Translate product knowledge into engaging learning systems using proven adult learning theory and training design methodologies.
Represent Product Training within product release meetings and ensure training content is updated in line with product developments.
Use WPP Open data points as they become available to measure training effectiveness and plan improvements to materials in response.
Work with the Product Enablement and Go To Marketing teams on supporting materials and communication strategies to equip users with the knowledge and skills to leverage product capabilities e ectively.
Proactively keep up to date with the latest research on customer education and marketing and bring forth ideas and recommendations as to their application.
WHAT WILL YOU NEED
Experience in either advertising/marketing or working on a software product.
Substantial experience with content design, curriculum development and delivery, and program coordination, with a proven ability to drive tangible end user adoption.
Solid understanding of adult learning principles, modern training techniques and training measurement frameworks.
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Proven experience in designing self-paced learning.
Experience with Articulate, Synthesia or other eLearning and video editing tools a bonus.
Familiarity with product development, lifecycles, agile working structures, project management.
Display high energy and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work e ectively in a global setting across localities and time zone.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Role: Quantitative Developer
Location: Mumbai/ Delhi (4 days working from office)
Shift: UK Shift (Afternoon Shift) (2:00pm to 11:00pm)
The Area: The Research & Investment group is a global team guided by Morningstars investment principles focused on delivering great long-term investment results to help end-investors reach their financial goals. We use our expertise in asset allocation, investment selection and portfolio construction to create world-class investment strategies leveraging the full resources of Morningstar. The group specializes in multi-asset investing, using building blocks in equities, fixed income and alternative investments to construct robust portfolios. Through our investment offerings, we serve financial advisers and institutions, and the investors that they serve.
Role Summary:
The Quantitative Developer will join the Systematic Strategies team in the Research & Investment group. This experienced professional will build scalable research infrastructure used by portfolio managers and quantitative researchers to develop, back test, and deploy multi asset models.
You should understand the nuances of the data and prepare it for ingestion, and your daily work with researchers and portfolio managers will facilitate the research, design, and deployment of investment strategies.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, cloud architecture, and financial systems.
Key Responsibilities:
The successful candidate will
Design and maintain scalable data pipelines for market, fundamental, and alternative datasets using Python, PySpark, FastAPI and AWS
Build and support investment data platforms, maintain databases and research datasets.
Integrate and automate data retrieval from internal/external providers such as FactSet, Morningstar, Axioma, and other third-party sources
Collaborate with quantitative researchers and portfolio managers to support enhancement of production workflows
Automate operational processes through workflow orchestration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices
Exposure to streaming data services and event-driven architectures used for real-time data ingestion, processing, and distribution
Evaluate and leverage AI/ML and Generative AI technologies to enhance analytics and operational efficiency
Requirements:
Strong expertise in Python, PySpark, and distributed data processing
Experience with Airflow, EMR, AWS Step Functions, Docker, Git, CI/CD, Terraform, and CloudFormation
Strong SQL skills and experience with Redshit, Athena, DataLake and Parquet
Experience of building AI agents & agentic workflow is desirable and will be considered a strong plus
Experience with handling financial data from vendors such as FactSet, Bloomberg, Morningstar, or Compustat
Exposure to portfolio analytics, risk modelling, performance attribution, and platforms such as Axioma, MSCI Barra, Bloomberg PORT, or similar solutions
Required Technical Skills
Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark
Experience with creating Data Pipelines
Exposure to cloud-based services, AWS (preferred)
Exposure to AI-powered productivity and development tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline
2+ years of experience in Quantitative Engineering, Data Engineering, or Platform Engineering within investment management or financial services
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.
AboutCompany: Morningstar, Inc. (Ticker: morn) a US Based NASDAQ listed Company. It is a leading provider of independent investment research in the United States and in major international markets.

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory

About the Company:

NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.

Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. As an AES Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer – Senior Associate- Operate, you will engage in the integration of Salesforce with various systems, applications, and databases to facilitate seamless data flow and process automation. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and enhancing your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing ambiguity and using these moments as opportunities for growth.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a team that specializes in consulting services for business applications, helping clients optimize operational efficiency. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. This position offers a unique opportunity to deepen your understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, while upholding professional and technical standards.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.
