Description:
Experience Management Supervising Associate
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you:
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy

We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.

As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines

Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Job Summary
Educational Sales / Promotion / Marketing Representative. Sales/promotion/marketing experience in the Book Trade. Creating a positive brand image/awareness of Deepshikha Books in junior schools, play schools, gift shops and bookshops. The candidate will visit play schools, junior schools and bookshops, meet junior school heads and principals to inform them about Deepshikhas product range, and also look out for promising teachers who could become good authors and encourage them to write new books to be published by Deepshikha. Candidates will stay alert to competing publishers products and strategies so Deepshikha can devise an appropriate marketing strategy. The candidate will be given a particular area/territory to work in, visiting all schools, play schools and bookshops (small to big), meeting customers, gathering relevant data and sharing it with the immediate senior / as advised by the marketing manager.

Sales/promotion/marketing experience in the Book Trade. Creating a positive brand image/awareness of Deepshikha Books in junior schools, play schools, gift shops and bookshops.

The candidate will be given a particular area/territory to work in, visiting all schools, play schools and bookshops (small to big), meeting customers, gathering relevant data and sharing it with the immediate senior / as advised by the marketing manager.

Knowledge
Basic knowledge of methods involved in presenting, promoting, and selling products or services.
Basic computer knowledge -- preparing sales presentations, sales letters, promotion through email and WhatsApp.
English and the regional language.
A fair idea of local locations/areas.
Skills
Talking to customers to effectively convey information.
Judging customer behaviour and moulding the sales pitch accordingly.
Interacting with customers to ascertain and evaluate their needs and wishes.
Listening to what the customer is saying and asking questions as appropriate.
The ability to speak clearly so as to be understandable to a customer.
Attitude
Sales strategies and tactics, product demonstration and sales techniques.
The ability to communicate information and ideas clearly in speech.
The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words.
Experience
Product detailing and presentation; front-line sales or cold-calling sales experience would be an added advantage.
Education
Any Graduate / Under Graduate / Post Graduate, preferably with a marketing background.

Description:
The SR DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER will be a key member of the Campaign Analytics team, responsible for transforming marketing intelligence through AI, automation, advanced analytics, and performance insights. This role will drive data-driven decision-making by proactively monitoring business performance, identifying trends, uncovering risks and opportunities, and delivering actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 812 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Global Employment & Labor Laws Compliance Manager (Advisory)
You are responsible for providing strategic oversight, regulatory assurance, litigation support, and stakeholder governance across employment compliance, statutory remittances, audits, policy implementation, and risk management, while partnering closely with HR, ERM, Legal, C&B, Audit, CISO, Business teams and external partners.
Key Responsibilities:
Employment & Labour Law Compliance:
F Ensure a strategic approach to ongoing compliances w.r.t employment and labour laws across India and Co’s operating entities and countries through structured assessments of data, processes, and policies.
F Identify compliance gaps, assess risks, and drive timely mitigation actions in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
F Maintain oversight of country specific employment compliance requirements and emerging regulatory changes impacting the organization along with country legal and HR leaders.
Statutory Registrations, Filings & Contributions (India)
F Procure, renew, and manage statutory licenses, registrations, and approvals related to employment from appropriate government authorities in India.
F Ensure accurate and timely submission of statutory reports, returns, declarations, and forms under applicable employment laws.
F Oversee remittance of statutory contributions such as ESIC and Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) within defined statutory timelines.
Vendor & Third-Party Employment Compliance
F Lead employment compliance assessments of vendors supporting Facilities Management Group (FMG) and Global Security Group (GSG) across offices in India.
Audits, Inspections & Regulatory Engagement
F Ensure timely availability of accurate, complete, and auditable data for Client audits, Government inspections, External statutory audits, Internal audits and assurance reviews
F Liaise with government authorities during inspections, inquiries, and compliance reviews.
F Participate in conciliation proceedings and represent the organization before labour authorities, tribunals, and courts.
Litigation, Disciplinary & Investigative Support
F Support employment related litigation matters by coordinating documentation, responses, and court submissions in India.
F Conduct and oversee inquiries related to background verification failures and disciplinary investigations.
F Execute absconding processes
Client, Contractual & Business Support
F Respond to employment compliance related information requests from existing and prospective clients.
F Support RFQs, due diligence, and contractual reviews by providing accurate employment compliance inputs and risk assessments.
Policy, SOP & Regulatory Documentation Enablement
F Partner with HR and policy owners to ensure timely updates and publication of employment policies and SOPs in response to regulatory changes and audit observations.
F Facilitate prioritisation, review, and compliance validation of policy and SOP content uploaded on internal knowledge platforms (e.g., The Dot), while working within defined access and ownership frameworks.
F Ensure alignment between documented policies/SOPs and actual operational practices from a compliance standpoint.
Data Privacy, Information Security & Records Governance
F Oversee employment related data privacy and information security compliance, including:
F Access management, Data retention and statutory record maintenance, Regulatory documentation, Privacy notices and consent artefacts
F Breach assessment and response support, Ensure app enrolment compliance in Configuration Management Databases and adherence to contractual data protection provisions.
Risk Management & Business Continuity
F Maintain the GPO risk register, conduct risk assessments, and track mitigation plans.
F Support employment compliance risk assessments for acquired entities as required.

Preferred candidate profile
1. LLB / LLM with a specialization in Labour/Employment Law with Minimum 5 Years of progressive experience in labour laws, employment compliance with a Leading Law Firm or BIG 4
2. Strong exposure to Indian labour legislation; global employment compliance experience is an advantage.
3. Proven experience handling government inspections, audits, conciliation proceedings, and court matters.
4. Experience supporting client audits, RFQs, and contractual compliance reviews.
Stakeholder Management & Key Competencies
Stakeholder Management:
I. Internal: HR, ERM, Legal, Internal Audit, Finance, Business Leaders, GPO Leadership
II. External: Government Authorities, Labour Inspectors, Statutory Bodies, Clients, Auditors, Legal Counsel, Vendors
Key Competencies:
A. Deep expertise in labour and employment laws.
B. Strong regulatory interpretation and risk assessment skills.
C. Ability to engage confidently with government authorities and auditors.
D. High attention to detail and documentation discipline.
E. Strong stakeholder management and influencing capabilities, holding partners accountable.
F. Ability to operate in high pressure, audit driven environments.
G. Sound judgment, integrity, and confidentiality.
H. Matrixed stake holder engagement with Legal, HR, C&B, ERM, External Partners etc.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems.

Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.

Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.


Qualification

Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.

Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.

Job Title - Manager - Process Excellence
Management Level:07 - Manager
Location:Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad
Must Have Skills
Strong expertise in B2B Sales process transformation, covering end-to-end Sales process steps such as Lead Management, Lead Qualification, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contract Management, Order Management, and Sales Operations.
Proven experience in future-state process design, process transformation, process optimization, and operating model design.
Strong ability to lead client discovery and design workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Experience integrating AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into business and Sales processes.
Strong understanding of Sales platforms and enterprise applications that enable the B2B Sales lifecycle.
Ability to connect business processes, technology, operating models, and organizational change to develop practical transformation solutions.
Strong team management and people leadership skills, including coaching, mentoring, work allocation, quality assurance, and developing junior practitioners.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present and defend recommendations to senior client leadership.
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with process mapping, process modeling, and visualization tools, including Microsoft Visio or equivalent applications.
Exposure to process mining, digital twin, process simulation, or other data-driven approaches for process assessment and validation.
Familiarity with AX Design and designing AI-agent experiences within business processes.
Experience supporting Business Development, sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, solutioning, and client presentations.
Experience conducting change-impact assessments across people, process, technology, data, skills, and operating models.
Knowledge of Sales platforms such as CRM (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), CPQ (Salesforce, Conga, SAP), CLM (Icertis Conga), Sales Planning (Anaplan, Xactly), Forecasting (Clari, Aviso), Incentive Compensation (Varicent, SAP Callidus), Order Management (Salesforce, SAP), and Revenue Management (Salesforce, SAP)
Experience
8 -12 years of experience in management consulting, process transformation, process excellence, Sales Operations, business transformation, or related areas.
Demonstrated experience leading process transformation workstreams and managing client and internal stakeholders.
Experience managing and developing consulting teams
Experience supporting BD, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities is preferred.

Educational Qualification
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent.
MBA/PGDM (Preferred)
Job Summary
As a Manager - B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence, you will lead the design and transformation of end-to-end B2B Sales processes for clients across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
You will own the process transformation design cycle-from understanding the client's current-state Sales processes and assessing industry, market, technology, and competitive forces, through defining future-state processes and operating models, to developing implementation and adoption approaches. You will bring strong knowledge of key Sales process steps, including Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, Account Management, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations. You will also assess how Sales platforms and applications enable these processes and identify opportunities for platform optimization, digital transformation, automation, and AI/GenAI integration.
The role requires strong consulting leadership, including client workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, executive communication, team management, and delivery ownership. You will lead and coach practitioners, ensure quality of deliverables, and build reusable methodologies and assets. You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including opportunity shaping, solution development, proposal responses, process narratives, capability presentations, and client presentations.
As part of AI-led transformation, you will apply AX Design principles to consider the intersection of human, AI agent, and process. Future-state process designs should define where AI agents operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, escalation triggers, controls, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.
Roles & Responsibilities
B2B Sales Process Transformation
Lead end-to-end B2B Sales process transformation initiatives across multiple Sales process steps and functional areas.
Assess current-state processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, control gaps, manual activities, duplication, and opportunities for standardization and automation.
Lead the design of future-state Sales processes and operating models aligned to business objectives and industry leading practices.
Drive transformation across key Sales processes including:
Lead Management & Qualification
Lead-to-Opportunity
Opportunity Management
Pipeline Management
Account Management
Sales Forecasting & Planning
CPQ & Deal Management
Contract Management
Order Management
Sales Operations & Revenue Operations
Connect process design with people, technology, data, governance, and operating model changes.
Develop transformation roadmaps, process specifications, business requirements, operating models, and implementation recommendations.
Sales Platforms & Applications
Assess the role of Sales platforms and applications in enabling end-to-end B2B Sales processes.
Support transformation initiatives involving CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, Incentive Compensation, Order Management, and Revenue Management platforms.
Identify opportunities to improve platform adoption, integration, automation, data quality, user experience, and process effectiveness.
Lead process visualization and documentation using Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling tools.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate process requirements into platform and solution requirements.
Client Leadership & Workshops
Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Facilitate discussions with Sales, Operations, Technology, Finance, and Business stakeholders.
Present transformation recommendations and future-state designs to senior client leadership.
Manage day-to-day client relationships, stakeholder expectations, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and establish credibility through strong Sales domain and consulting expertise.
AI, GenAI & AX Design
Embed AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into future-state Sales process designs and team ways of working.
Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve Sales productivity, decision-making, forecasting, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.
Use appropriate AI tools to accelerate research, benchmarking, analysis, process documentation, and deliverable creation.
Apply AX Design principles to future-state process specifications by defining:
AI-agent responsibilities
Autonomy levels
Decision-making boundaries
Escalation triggers
Human intervention points
Human-agent handoff protocols
Quality and governance requirements
Evaluate how AI agents and human users should collaborate across individual Sales process steps.
Process Excellence, Benchmarking & Analytics
Lead process maturity, benchmarking, and performance assessments to identify transformation opportunities.
Assess market and industry trends across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
Leverage AI-assisted analytics and benchmarking tools to develop data-driven insights.
Use process mining, digital twin, and process simulation approaches where appropriate to validate current-state and future-state process designs.
Develop change-impact assessments covering people, process, technology, data, skills, and organizational structures.
Business Development & RFP
Contribute actively to Business Development, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
Support opportunity qualification, solution shaping, and development of differentiated value propositions.
Lead or contribute to RFP responses, proposal narratives, solution approaches, process diagrams, operating models, case studies, and capability presentations.
Translate client requirements into practical B2B Sales transformation solutions and roadmaps.
Support client presentations, solution demonstrations, workshops, and pursuit discussions.
Develop reusable Sales transformation assets, accelerators, frameworks, and points of view to support future pursuits.
Team Management & People Leadership
Lead and manage consulting teams across Sales transformation engagements.
Allocate work, establish priorities, monitor delivery quality, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
Coach and mentor junior consultants and practitioners on B2B Sales processes, process redesign, consulting methodologies, analytics, and AI-enabled transformation.
Provide regular feedback and support team members in developing consulting and domain capabilities.
Foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment across onsite, offshore, and distributed teams.
Build team capabilities through knowledge sharing, training, reusable assets, and hands-on coaching.
Ensure appropriate quality reviews and adherence to Accenture delivery and consulting standards.
Professional & Technical Skills
Deep understanding of B2B Sales processes and end-to-end Sales process steps.
Proven experience in process transformation, future-state process design, process excellence, and operating model design.
Strong knowledge of Sales Operations and Sales transformation.
Experience with Sales platforms and applications supporting the B2B Sales lifecycle.
Proficiency or working knowledge of Microsoft Visio and process mapping/modeling tools.
Experience applying AI, GenAI, automation, and AI-assisted analytics to business process transformation.
Strong benchmarking, analytical, problem-solving, and structured-thinking capabilities.
Experience developing executive-level presentations, process specifications, transformation roadmaps, and business cases.
Strong client-facing consulting and stakeholder management skills.
Strong team leadership, coaching, mentoring, and people management capabilities.
Business Development & Consulting Skills
Demonstrated experience contributing to BD, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
Ability to develop client-ready solution approaches, proposals, presentations, and supporting artifacts.
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills.
Ability to translate complex process, technology, and AI concepts into clear business recommendations.
Experience facilitating senior stakeholder workshops and presenting recommendations to leadership.
Ability to manage multiple priorities across client delivery, team management, and business development.
Industry Focus
The role will primarily support clients across:
Software & Platforms
High Tech
Communications & Media
The Manager is expected to build strong knowledge of industry-specific B2B Sales models, Go-to-Market strategies, Sales operating models, Sales processes, technology landscapes, and emerging AI opportunities.

Additional Information
Strong interest and demonstrated experience in B2B Sales transformation, Sales Operations, digital transformation, AI/GenAI, and emerging Sales technologies.
Ability to bridge business processes, technology, data, AI, and operating model considerations.

Description:
About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Analyst

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:11 - Analyst

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 2-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:2-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

About The Role


Management Level: Ind Func AI Decision Science Consultant


Location: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Gurugram (Gurgaon), Hyderabad, Chennai.


Must-have skills: Programming languages -Python/R, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), ML libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Torch, Lang Chain, or OpenAI API, RAG Applications.



Good to have skills:Big data technologies such as Spark or Hadoop,AI model explainability(XAI),bias detection and AI ethics. Familiarity with Edge AI and deploying models on embedded devices for industrial automation. Experience with Reinforcement Learning (RL) and AI-driven optimization techniques.


Experience: Minimum 3-6 years of relevant Data Science, Machine Learning or AI-related roles., Exposure to Industrial Automotive Firms or Professional Services.



Educational Qualification: Bachelor/Master degree in Statistics/Economics/ Mathematics/ Computer Science or related disciplines with an excellent academic record or MBA from top-tier universities.


Job

Summary
We are looking for a Data Scientist / AI Specialist with 3-6 years of experience to join our team and work on client projects in the Automotive Industrial sectors. This role will involve leveraging traditional Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI (GenAI), Agentic AI, and Autonomous AI Systems to drive innovation, optimize processes, and enhance decision-making in complex industrial environments.
Prior experience in the Auto/Industrial industry is a plus, but we welcome candidates from any domain with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for applying AI to real-world business challenges.






Roles Responsibilities:

Develop, deploy and monitor AI/ML models in production environments enterprise systems, including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and process optimization for clients.
Work with Generative AI models (e.g., GPT, Stable Diffusion, DALLE) for applications such as content generation, automated documentation, code synthesis, and intelligent assistants.
Implement Agentic AI systems, including AI-powered automation, self-learning agents, and decision-support systems for industrial applications.
Design and build Autonomous AI solutions for tasks like predictive maintenance, supply chain optimization, and robotic process automation (RPA).
Work with structured and unstructured data from various sources, including IoT sensors, manufacturing logs, and customer interactions.
Optimize and fine-tune LLMs (Large Language Models) for specific business applications, ensuring ethical and explainable AI use.
Utilize MOps and AI orchestration tools to streamline model deployment, monitoring, and retraining cycles.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineers, business analysts, and domain experts, to align AI solutions with business objectives.
Stay updated with cutting-edge AI research in Generative AI, Autonomous AI, and Multi-Agent Systems.



Qualification




Professional Technical


Skills:
3-6 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI-related roles.
Proficiency in Python (preferred) or R, and experience with ML libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Torch, Lang Chain, or OpenAI API.
Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and their practical applications.
Hands-on experience in fine-tuning and deploying foundation models (e.g., OpenAI, Llama, Claude, Gemini, etc.).
Experience with Vector Databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, Pinecone) for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications.
Knowledge of Autonomous AI Agents (e.g., AutoGPT, BabyAGI) and multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for AI/ML model deployment.
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
Ability to communicate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Bonus:Experience in Automotive, Industrial, or Manufacturing AI applications (e.g., predictive maintenance, quality inspection, digital twins).






Additional Information:
Bachelor/Masters degree in Statistics/Economics/ Mathematics/ Computer Science or related disciplines with an excellent academic record /MBA from top-tier universities.
Excellent Communication and Interpersonal Skills.

Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.
For more details about us, please check:
Visit : HIAL Website or watch: About HIAl Job Description:
Looking for an experienced content creator who has proven ability to develop content and experience of writing good quality engaging articles. Has an ability to conduct extensive research on the assigned topic. A team player who has good coordination skills to collate the data at hand from different stake holders. The right candidate will be the one who is able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables and take ownership of the expected output without supervision.
About The Role:
As a content writer / you shall get to create content that shares HIAL's story, vision and brand to the world and make an impact across many different digital / social / media platforms.
Responsibilities:
1.Write, edit, publish content for websites, blogs, vlogs, videos, social media campaign (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc).
2.Creating compelling headlines and body content that will capture the attention of the target audience.
3.Write content for Annual Report, Newsletter and other internal communication initiatives.
4.Design content marketing strategy.
5.Optimise content considering SEO.
6.Should have the ability to work independently and with cross functional teams.
7.Should be able to come up with fresh ideas and take ownership of projects.
8.Ensure that the content adheres to required branding and style guidelines and is relevant for our target audience.
9.Scripting for audio-visual, written and other media content.
10.Plan and Execute Events and Conferences that are integral to HIAL.
11.Monitor HIAL's Social Media and online presence and timely preparing high quality content for promoting HIAL brand value.
12.Prepare HIAL Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly) collating data as required from all stakeholders.
13.While ensuring that they adhere to standards and goals of the HIAL, write and produce high-quality materials for effectively communicating to the key audience at appropriate platforms.
14.Create creative content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to maintain an active online presence for HIAL.
15.Content for press releases, media briefings etc for HIAL's media relations across radio, print, digital, and television.
16.Assure uniformity in all content by serving as key brand guardian of HIAL.
17.Maintain the content of HIALs website by making sure it is correct, up to date, and persuasive.
18.Have an eye for detail and make sure all output is of a high quality.
19.Able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables.

KRA:
1.Written content for communication with HIAL's stakeholders.
2.Preparation and circulation of Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly), brochures/ manuals, etc.
3.Branding and marketing related content.
4.Support in promoting the events organised time to time with valuable content for marketing and branding.
5.Social Media: Preparation of high quality and engaging content for all the social media handles as per tentative schedule mentioned below with SEO.
1. Instagram: Ensure daily effective posts.
2.Any Event: Instant Posting.
3.Facebook: Ensure daily effective posts.
4.Twitter
5.LinkedIn
6.Website
6.Content for the Events:
1.Annual Conferences & Festivals, promotion activities (Sun & Earth, Education, Entrepreneurship, Energy Studies).
2.Workshops.

7.I Live Simply (ILS).
1.Manage content related activities for ILS.


Preferred Educational Background:
1.Graduate or Master's in Mass Communication/ English literature or equivalent.
2.Good command over English.
3.Proven experience working under strict deadlines and the ability to work quickly.
4.Creative skills and usage of photographs, drawings, diagrams, animation, etc
The above is relaxed for the right candidate who can prove excellence in lines with the requirement with proven track record.
Preferred Work Experience:
1.Minimum of 2-5 years in similar roles.
2.Ability to work independently and reliably with minimal supervision.
3.Experience in SEO will be preferred.
4.Creative writing.
Compensation:
As per industry and region standards.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in photography and videography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating technical proficiency and creative vision.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Description:
Position Overview:
HIAL is looking for a dynamic and people-centered HR Manager who can lead and manage the institute's human resource functions in a proactive, empathetic and organized manner. The ideal candidate should be passionate about creating an inclusive, growth-oriented and values-driven work culture while aligning HR practices with the institute's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Strategy & Policy Development:
Design, review and implement HR policies and procedures that reflect the institute's ethos and ensure legal compliance.
Support long-term HR planning, including workforce planning, succession planning and talent development.
2. Recruitment & Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process for faculty, administrative and support staff.
Develop effective strategies for talent acquisition, including campus outreach and collaborations.
Ensure smooth onboarding and orientation of new employees.
3. Performance Management & Capacity Building:
Design and implement fair and constructive performance appraisal systems.
Identify training needs and coordinate internal and external capacity-building initiatives.
Support managers in developing individual growth plans for their teams.
4. Employee Engagement & Culture:
Foster a healthy, inclusive and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect and collective purpose.
Plan and execute employee engagement activities, feedback mechanisms and team-building initiatives.
Serve as a bridge between staff and leadership, ensuring two-way communication.
5. HR Operations & Compliance:
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records including attendance, leave and service history.
Manage HR-related documentation, including contracts, policies and compliance with labor laws.
Oversee payroll coordination, benefits and timely employee reimbursements in collaboration with the Finance team.
6. Conflict Resolution & Welfare:
Address staff grievances with empathy and fairness, ensuring timely resolution.
Promote mental health and staff well-being initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Organizational Development, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in an academic or social sector organization is preferred.
Strong understanding of HR laws, best practices and systems.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a multicultural, high-altitude and mission-driven environment.
Desirable Attributes:
Sensitivity to local culture and a passion for sustainable development in the Himalayan region.
Adaptability and willingness to live and work in a remote, cold desert setting.
Experience with HR tech platforms and digital tools.
Ability to handle both strategic HR planning and hands-on operational tasks.

Job Title: Business Development Manager (School Marketing)
Location: nagaland, jammu & kashmir and ladakh
Qualification: Graduate / Master's
Experience: 2-5 years

About Us
K12 Techno Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading education service provider in India, offering a dynamic suite of academic support, services and solutions to schools. K12 enables schools to leverage its expertise, technology and services to deliver a global approach towards education.
About School
ORCHIDS The International School is a leading chain of progressive schools in India, committed to providing quality education that fosters the holistic development of students.

Key Responsibilities
Business Development: Drive student admissions and achieve enrolment targets for the assigned school/branch through effective lead generation and conversion.
Channel Partnerships: Identify and build relationships with preschools, daycare centres, tuition centres, activity centres, educational consultants and other relevant partners to generate admission leads.
Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with channel partners, prospective parents and local stakeholders to support admission growth.

BTL Marketing: Execute local BTL marketing activities, campaigns and community outreach initiatives to increase school visibility and generate leads.

Events & Lead Generation: Coordinate and participate in school events, open houses and promotional activities to generate quality leads and drive conversions.

Performance Tracking: Track leads, conversions and partner performance and prepare regular reports to support achievement of admission targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile 1-2 years of experience in the education sector is mandatory, preferably in school admissions, education sales, EdTech, preschool, K-12 or related sectors. Prior experience in sales, business development, admissions, marketing or channel partnerships is preferred. Strong relationship-building, communication and convincing skills. Energetic, extroverted and target-driven personality. Ability to build relationships with parents, partners and external stakeholders. Willingness to work in the field and achieve business targets.
Details
Work Mode: Onsite / Field-based (School Branch) Working Days: 6 days per week (with 1 rotational day off) Compensation: Competitive salary + Performance-based incentives

F&B Production 2-4 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
The Marketing Manager at the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to promote responsible tourism-related events, projects and activities, as well as promoting various courses, conferences, and workshops offered by the institute. The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:
Plan and execute marketing initiatives to promote conferences, workshops, and seminars held at the institute.
Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and participants to ensure successful event promotion.
Manage event registration and attendee communication.
Digital Marketing:
Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Create and curate content that highlights the institute's mission and values.
Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.
Foster relationships with local and regional stakeholders to enhance the institute's presence.
Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.
This Marketing Manager will play a crucial role in promoting the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh's mission to promote responsible tourism and education in the region, while also fostering awareness and participation in its various courses, conferences, and workshops.

Description:

F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Willingness to work in permanent night shifts.
Comfortable working 5 days a week with 2 rotational week-offs.
Candidates should be willing to work from the Chandigarh location.

Description:
Role Name: SAP BASIS Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli
Work Mode: Hybrid
Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system upgrades, migrations, refreshes, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, and HANA database environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform user administration, role assignments, security, and authorization support.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, Disaster Recovery, and High Availability configurations.
Support incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis.
Collaborate with functional, development, infrastructure, and cloud teams.
Support implementation, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Ensure system availability, reliability, and compliance with organizational standards.

Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP BASIS Administration.
Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA landscapes
Experience in Kernal Upgrade and Solution Management.
Strong knowledge of:
SAP HANA Database Administration
SAP NetWeaver Administration
Transport Management System (TMS)
SAP System Monitoring
Performance Tuning
Client Copy/System Copy
Kernel Upgrades and Patch Management
Experience in SAP installation, upgrade, and migration activities.
Knowledge of SAP security, users, roles, and authorizations.
Experience in troubleshooting SAP system performance issues.
Understanding of Backup, Recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery concepts.
Experience in Linux/Unix operating systems.
Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills
SAP S/4HANA Conversion or Migration projects.
Exposure to SAP Solution Manager.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
HANA database migration and administration experience.

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store

Description:
Role & Responsibilities:

* Handle walk-in candidates and counsel them regarding visa processes, documentation, eligibility, and available overseas opportunities.
* Call and follow up with leads generated through Meta (Facebook and Instagram) advertisements.
* Convert online leads into walk-in appointments, counselling sessions, and enrolled candidates.
* Understand candidates requirements and recommend suitable visa counselling or overseas career services.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective candidates and manage lead data in the CRM or Excel.
* Achieve monthly targets for lead conversion, counselling, and admissions.
* Coordinate with the internal team to ensure a smooth candidate journey from the first enquiry to enrolment.

Preferred Candidate Profile:

* Prior experience in immigration, visa counselling, tele-sales, or education counselling is preferred.
* Strong communication, convincing, and sales skills.
* Ability to convert online leads into paying clients through effective counselling and follow-ups.
* Comfortable making outbound calls, handling walk-ins, and managing multiple enquiries.
* Target-oriented, proactive, and confident in dealing with prospective candidates.
* Freshers with excellent communication and sales aptitude may also apply.

Perks and Benefits:

* Fixed salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to grow in the overseas education, immigration, and international career services sector.
* Supportive work environment with opportunities for learning and career growth.

Job Responsibility

Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
