Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Responsible for providing short-term, specialized patient care, diagnostic monitoring, and minor surgical procedures that do not require overnight hospitalization.

Clinical & Patient Care
Outpatient Consultations (OPD): Conduct primary medical examinations, take comprehensive patient histories, and assess acute or chronic illnesses.
Daycare Management: Supervise and manage short-stay patients undergoing procedures like IV fluid therapies, chemotherapy sessions, dialysis, blood transfusions, or prolonged diagnostic monitoring.
Minor Procedures: Perform or assist in minor surgical or medical procedures such as wound suturing, dressings, incision and drainage (I&D), foreign body removal, and catheterization.
Diagnostic Interpretation: Order and evaluate basic clinical investigations (e.g., blood tests, X-rays, ECGs) to formulate quick and accurate treatment plans.
Emergency & Stabilization
Acute Care & Triage: Identify critical shifts in a patient's vital signs or general condition during their short stay.
Emergency Management: Administer first-line emergency medical care and stabilize patients experiencing sudden medical crises before coordinating transfers to higher care centers.
Operations & Administration
Multidisciplinary Liaison: Coordinate closely with nursing staff, specialist consultants, and administrators to ensure seamless patient care and timely discharges.
Medical Documentation: Maintain highly precise Electronic Medical Records (EMR), including admission notes, procedure records, drug charts, and discharge summaries.
Referrals & Follow-ups: Structure comprehensive discharge guidelines and schedule routine outpatient follow-up care.

Qualifications & Licensing
Degree: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized medical council.
Licensure: Valid and active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC)

Description:
About Us :
Paytm is Indias leading mobile payments and financial services platform. As the pioneer of mobile QR payments, we empower millions of merchants and consumers to transact digitally. Our mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy using innovative technology.

About the team :
EDC & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the Role :
Were looking for a dynamic Team Leader to drive EDC device sales under the Railway Transit. You will be responsible for managing a team of field executives, driving distribution, and ensuring consistent growth in merchant onboarding and transaction volumes.

Key Responsibilities :
1. Lead and manage a field sales team of 5 or more members
2. Drive EDC machine sales and deployment in the oil & gas sector (e.g., petrol pumps, distributors, etc.)
3. Build and maintain strong channel partner relationships
4. Ensure target achievement through proper team coordination and ground execution
5. Monitor daily productivity, quality of acquisitions, and incentive earnings
6. Train, guide, and motivate team to perform and scale
7. Analyze market trends and competitor activities
8. Regular reporting and MIS handling using Excel and sales tools

Requirements / Expectations :
1. Must have a smartphone, bike, and helmet
2. Minimum 3 years of experience in channel sales & distribution
3. Proven experience in leading field sales teams
4. Strong knowledge of merchant onboarding, incentives, and field sales operations
5. Experience in POS/EDC device sales will be preferred
6. Familiar with metrics-based sales tracking and incentive planning

Education :
Graduate (mandatory); Post-Graduation preferred

Description:
QC Analyst
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform analysis of raw materials, packing materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples as per approved specifications and test methods.
Operate and maintain analytical instruments such as HPLC, GC, UV-Visible Spectrophotometer, FTIR, Dissolution Apparatus, and other laboratory equipment.
Prepare, standardize, and maintain laboratory reagents, volumetric solutions, and reference standards.
Review analytical data, maintain laboratory records, and ensure compliance with GDP, GLP, and data integrity requirements.
Investigate OOS, OOT, laboratory incidents, and deviations as per approved procedures.
Participate in method verification, method transfer, and analytical method validation activities.
Ensure timely completion of sample analysis and reporting.
Support regulatory audits, customer audits, and internal audits.
Follow cGMP, safety, and quality systems requirements.

Microbiologist -
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform microbiological testing of raw materials, finished products, purified water, and environmental monitoring samples.
Conduct environmental monitoring of manufacturing areas, including viable and non-viable monitoring.
Perform microbial limit tests, sterility testing, endotoxin testing, and growth promotion tests.
Prepare and manage microbiological culture media and microbial cultures.
Carry out water system monitoring and trend analysis.
Maintain microbiology laboratory records in compliance with GDP, GLP, cGMP, and data integrity requirements.
Investigate OOS, OOT, deviations, and microbiological excursions.
Participate in method validation, method suitability studies, and qualification activities.
Ensure laboratory housekeeping, equipment calibration, and compliance with safety requirements.
Support internal, regulatory, and customer audits.

Qualification
B.Sc./M.Sc. (Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology) or equivalent qualification.
Experience
2-4 Years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical formulation/API manufacturing company.
Skills Required
  Knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, and Data Integrity.
Hands-on experience with analytical instruments (for QC Analyst) and microbiological testing techniques (for Microbiologist).
Good documentation and investigation skills.
Exposure to regulatory requirements of USFDA, MHRA, EU GMP, WHO GMP, etc.

JOB DESCRIPTION-OPTOMETRIST
Title Optometrist/Sr. Optometrist
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers’ eye powers.
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
dispensing lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product
recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Interested Candidate Share CV;- 9163548175 (HR Santanu Mondal)

Regards,
Santanu Mondal
santanu.mondal@lenskart.com

Job Description
A Sales Advisor is responsible for delivering the best customer experience that contributes to the store s sales and profit. As a Sales Advisor, you ll always put customers first, offer assistance, and share your product and fashion knowledge. You ll create an environment that is easy for customers to shop through store operations and great garment care. You will also share your knowledge and skills with your colleagues, offering help where needed to build positive working environment.
Key Responsibilities
Provide great customer experience.
Fold, hang, display and merchandise garments to maximise selling opportunities.
Actively process, stock and replenish garments on the sales floor and in the stock room.
Open, unpack and label merchandise with security tags.
Support customer purchases and returns in the register. Qualifications
To be successful in the role as Sales Advisor, we believe you are a team player with a proactive and helpful approach, fostering collaboration and collective success. You have a positive mindset, where you are eager, optimistic and motivated when interacting with colleagues and customers. We also believe you are flexible and able to adjust to changing circumstances and customer needs, and that you can take initiatives and independently in a quick and effective way address customers needs. In addition, you are communicative and socially confident, fostering a positive interaction with colleagues and customers.
What you need to succeed:
Previous experience within retail, merchandising and/or customer service.
Effective time management - being stress-resistant and good at prioritisation.
Have a customer service mindset where you always prioritise the customers needs while serving as a brand ambassador.
Being fashion knowledgeable and have a genuine interest in fashion trends.
Have a selling mindset with the ability to approach and fulfil customer needs.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.

Relevant years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in Web Automation Testing.

Job Description: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant (6 to 10 Years)
Position: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12Years
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gandhinagar
Interview Type: Face-to-Face
Date:10-OCTOBER-2026

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant with 4 to 10 years of SAP Sales and Distribution experience. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAP SD business processes, S/4HANA implementations, configuration, integrations, and support projects.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Configure SAP SD modules including:
Sales Order Processing
Pricing
Billing
Shipping & Transportation
Output Management
Credit Management
Returns & Rebate Processes
Participate in S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Work on integrations with MM, FI, WM/EWM, TM, and PP modules.
Conduct fit-gap analysis and prepare functional specifications.
Support testing activities including Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Go-Live.
Provide end-user training and post-go-live support.
Collaborate with technical teams for enhancements, reports, forms, interfaces, and workflows.
Required Skills
6 to 10 years of SAP SD consulting experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation project.
Strong configuration knowledge in:
Enterprise Structure
Sales Document Types
Item Categories
Schedule Lines
Pricing Procedures
Output Determination
Partner Determination
Copy Controls
Batch Management
Experience with S/4HANA SD simplifications and business processes.
Knowledge of APIs, IDOCs, EDI, and interfaces.
Strong understanding of OTC (Order-to-Cash) processes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with SAP Fiori applications.
Exposure to SAP EWM, TM, GTS, or SAP CAR.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in AMS support and global rollout projects.
SAP SD or S/4HANA certification is preferred
CompanyAddress: Godrej and Boyce Compound, Plant No. 05,LBS Marg, Vikhroli - West, Mumbai, NAVI MUMBAI, Maharashtra, India

Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Location: Bangalore HSR Layout
Work Mode: Onsite | Mon - Sat | 10:00AM to 7:30PM
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 6 Months – 5 Years
Market: Indian & ROW
Joining: Immediate Joiners / Candidates with up to 15 days’ notice preferred

About Simplilearn
Simplilearn is a global EdTech platform offering industry-relevant programs across Data Science, AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Digital Marketing and other digital economy skills.

Role Overview
We are looking for Inside Sales professionals who can engage with prospective learners, understand their career goals and recommend the right learning programs through a consultative sales approach.
The role involves managing the complete sales cycle — from lead engagement and follow-ups to objection handling, negotiation and conversion.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with prospective learners through outbound calls and lead engagement.
Understand customer needs and recommend relevant programs.
Drive lead conversion and revenue through consultative selling.
Follow up consistently and maintain strong customer engagement.
Handle objections, negotiations and customer concerns effectively.
Achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.
Maintain accurate lead and customer records in CRM.

What We’re Looking For
6 months – 5 years of experience in B2C / Inside Sales.
EdTech sales experience is an added advantage.
Experience selling high-ticket degree, certification or professional programs will be preferred.
Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong sales acumen, persuasion and convincing skills.
Good follow-up and objection-handling abilities.
Strong negotiation and closing skills.
Target-driven, self-motivated and comfortable working in a high-performance sales environment.
Graduates from any discipline are eligible.

Why Simplilearn?
Opportunity to work with a global EdTech organization.
Performance-driven career growth.
Access to Simplilearn's learning and development ecosystem.
Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:
shreya.dn@simplilearn.net
AboutCompany:
We are the world€™s largest professional certifications company.

A pioneer in online education for professionals, we create course programs, exams, and lab projects that help professionals across the world successfully prepare for and complete certification exams with ease. Our unique blended model of training brings together the best of self-learning and online training, making for a successful learning experience.

We strive to constantly improve our learning frameworks to make them more user-friendly. Our courses are upgraded continuously to ensure our learners are up-to-date on the latest industry requirements and best practices.

We assist our learners in applying for the certification exam of their choice, and our vibrant community of experts and certified professionals is a powerful resource pool of tips, tricks, and insightful advice.

Associate will be responsible for ensuring completion of delivery of day-to-day transactions and activities within the Record-to-Report (R2R) function/process, (for e.g., GL Accounting, Period End Close, Reporting, etc.)

Performance and day-to-day delivery of R2R processes, sub-processes, activities, and transactions enteries

Complete tax workpapers and reporting
Management and tracking of the close checklist
Perform reconciliations, including BS reconciliations

Preparing financial statements
Participate in month-end close
Internal Controls
SOX Reporting
SOX & risk compliance activities

Manage activities across fixed assets, inter-company, bank reconciliations
Experience in preparation of SOPs and managing SLAs
Provide necessary documentation and reports for financial reporting.
Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting principles, and relevant regulations.
Stay informed about changes in accounting standards and best practices in R2R function
Support Team Lead (as required) in areas such as:
Operational Excellence
Process Improvements
Reporting
Client Management / Escalations

Description:
Territory Sales Manager (TSM)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue
by onboarding new apartment complexes and societies into NoBrokerHood by meeting with prospective clients in
person and explaining the product.
Job Description:-



Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

Meet prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, and emphasize product features and
benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices
Meet with Committee Members of Apartments and Societies,accounting services partners and builders to
understand the scope of business and their expectations.




Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities
Onboarding new apartments on the NoBrokerHood platform will be a major KRA.
Researching potential leads from the open market, web searches, or digital resources.
Mandatory requirements for this position





Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location
will be a plus).






Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.
Geographical knowledge of the job location is an added advantage.
What we have to offer!

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Uncapped variables based on performance
Benefits





Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions for the outstanding performers
AboutCompany: NoBroker is Indias first and only PropTech Unicorn, transforming the real estate ecosystem with cutting-edge, tech-driven, and capital-efficient solutions. Through NoBrokerHood, our smart society and community management platform, we empower over 21,000+ societies across 15 major cities—offering seamless visitor management, billing, and engagement experiences.

Description:
Job Summary
Company: Alstom
Location: Bangalore
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
Could you be the full-time OCS CAD Operator in India were looking for


Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your AutoCAD expertise in a cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative and detail-oriented teammates.
You'll contribute to the design and delivery of innovative OCS projects, ensuring high-quality outputs that meet technical and project requirements. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (including OCS Design Leaders, Construction Managers, and BIM Teams), support the creation of essential design documents, and much more.
Youll specifically take care of producing OCS Basic Design documents, such as general arrangements, technical specifications, and layouts, but also detailed design and installation drawings, including OCS layout plans, single-line diagrams, and mounting sheets.
Creating and managing OCS Basic Design documents (e.g., general arrangements, layouts, cross-sections)
Delivering detailed design, installation, and as-built drawings (e.g., OCS schematics, structural erection drawings)
Supporting documentation, such as bills of quantities, cable lists, and calculation studies
Contributing to configuration and change management processes
Maintaining proper version control and archiving of design documents
Providing Return on Experience (REX) inputs and participating in tools development and updates


All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
Diploma or B Tech in any Engineering discipline
Expertise in AutoCAD, particularly in using the Xref function
Understanding of technical drawing and industrial design basics
Ability to visualize 3D constraints, particularly in civil works
Knowledge and application of CAD standards
23 years of experience using CAD software (mandatory)
Experience working with interfaces between systems (desirable)
Strong team spirit, effective communication skills, and attention to detail
Self-motivation, initiative, and a fast-learning mindset in technical domains


Things you'll enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
Work with new security standards for rail signalling
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects
Utilise our inclusive and supportive working environment
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Progress towards roles such as OCS Design Leader or Technical Manager
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!


Important to note
As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations


Your Role

Architect, deploy, and maintain on-premise VMware Workspace ONE (AirWatch) environments, ensuring high availability, secure database integrations, and seamless communication between components such as UAG and ACC.
Configure and administer Microsoft Intune environments, designing robust Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM) solutions.
Manage the complete lifecycle of Android Enterprise devices (Work Profile, Fully Managed, Dedicated) and iOS/iPadOS devices.
Design and implement compliance policies, configuration profiles, conditional access policies, and certificate-based authentication mechanisms.
Manage integrations with Apple Business Manager (ABM), Apple Push Notification Service (APNs), Managed Google Play, and enterprise identity platforms.
Lead client discovery workshops, gather business and security requirements, and translate them into scalable mobility solutions.
Present architecture designs, deployment roadmaps, and strategic recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.



Your Profile

9 - 12 years of experience in Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM), Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), Mobile Device Management (MDM), and mobility architecture.
Strong hands-on experience with VMware Workspace ONE (On-Premise), including architecture, deployment, administration, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
Extensive experience managing and configuring Microsoft Intune for device enrollment, application management, compliance, and security.
Expert knowledge of Android Enterprise deployment models, OEM configurations, and iOS/iPadOS management frameworks.
Experience implementing Conditional Access, Zero Trust principles, certificate-based authentication, and mobile security controls.
Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), identity integration, and enterprise mobility security.
Experience integrating UEM platforms with Apple Business Manager (ABM), APNs, Managed Google Play, Okta, Ping, and other identity providers.
Ability to develop Statements of Work (SoW), High-Level Design (HLD) documents, technical documentation, and user adoption guides.



What will you love working at Capgemini

Work on enterprise-scale digital workplace and mobility transformation programs for global clients across multiple industries.
Gain hands-on exposure to next-generation endpoint management, Zero Trust security architectures, and modern workplace technologies.
Collaborate with global teams and client stakeholders to design and implement cutting-edge UEM solutions using Workspace ONE, Intune, Android Enterprise, and Apple ecosystems.
Build expertise in cloud security, identity management, compliance automation, and endpoint security frameworks.

Description:
Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.
Kindly schedule L1 evaluations if candidate meets the following criteria

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Description:
SAP FI-DRC JD

About the Role
Capgemini is looking for an experienced SAP FICO Consultant with expertise in SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) to support implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong functional knowledge of SAP Finance and Controlling processes along with hands-on experience in statutory reporting, e-Invoicing, and compliance solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP FICO solutions.
Configure and support SAP FICO modules:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Bank Accounting
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Product Costing
Profitability Analysis (COPA)
Implement and support SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC).
Manage statutory reporting and regulatory compliance requirements.
Work on GST compliance, e-Invoicing, e-Way Bill, and tax reporting processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Prepare functional specifications and support development activities.
Provide production support and resolve application issues.

Required Skills
6+ years of SAP FICO along with 3+ yrs in SAP DRC experience.
Hands-on experience in SAP FICO configuration and support.
Strong experience in SAP DRC (Document and Reporting Compliance).
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance.
Experience integrating SAP FICO with MM and SD modules.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Preferred Skills
SAP S/4HANA implementation experience.
Experience in global rollouts, migrations, or support projects.
Experience in GST, e-Invoicing, and statutory reporting requirements.
SAP Certification in SAP FICO or SAP S/4HANA Finance.
Exposure to Central Finance, Group Reporting, or FSCM.

Job Title: GenAI Developer/ Engineer
About Us
Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.
WHY JOIN CAPCO?
You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.
MAKE AN IMPACT
Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.
#BEYOURSELFATWORK
Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.
CAREER ADVANCEMENT
With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.
DIVERSITY & INCLUSION
We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.
Location - Pune
Experience - 5 to 10
Skills and Qualifications:
AI Engineer:
Key Responsiblities: 1. System Development: Designing and building AI models, such as neural networks, that learn from data and mimic human cognitive functions 2. Production Deployment: Transitioning research-level ML models into scalable, operational applications via APIs, microservices, or cloud platforms. 3. Data Handling & Training: Selecting, managing, and training models using large datasets, including natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision tasks. 4. Testing & Optimization: Evaluating accuracy, debugging, and improving AI performance to ensure systems run efficiently. 5. Collaboration: Working with data scientists and software engineers to align AI solutions with business objectives.
Required Skills and Qualifications: 1. Programming languages: Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or C++. How to use AI tooling to build up capability. Any UI/API automation framework. 2. ML Frameworks: Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or Scikit-learn. How to use MCP server. 3. Data & Cloud Tools: Proficiency in SQL, Big Data Technologies, and cloud platforms like AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud 4. Technical Skills: Expertise in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and algorithm development. 5. Education: Typically requires a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

Interested candidates please reply with below details to proceed ahead.

Description:
Python Full Stack Developer (React.js)

Experience
6-9 Years

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Python Full Stack Developer with strong experience in React.js and modern web application development. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance applications across the front-end and back-end layers.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain web applications using Python and React.js.
Design and build RESTful APIs and microservices using frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
Implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces using React.js, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
Integrate front-end components with back-end services and databases.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
Collaborate with product owners, architects, QA teams, and other developers.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and production support activities.
Contribute to CI/CD pipeline implementation and cloud deployments.

Required Skills
Strong experience in Python development.
Hands-on experience with React.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
Experience with Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and API integrations.
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD tools, and Agile methodologies.
Understanding of authentication, authorization, and web security best practices.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of Redis, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
Exposure to automated testing frameworks.
Experience with DevOps and containerized deployments.

Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Location : Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai.

Please share your updated resume - Hemanth.kumars1@mphasis.com

We are looking for only Immediate joiners or Max 15 Days notice period.

Description:
Hi Everyone,
Hope youre doing well!
We have an urgent opening for a SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant of our esteemed clients.

Experience Required: 10 – 15 Years
Location: Hyderabad,Bangalore,Pune,Mumbai,Noida,Chennai
Employment Type: Full-time
Education: B. Tech / M. Tech / M.Sc. / MCA

Position Overview
Job Descripition:

We are seeking an experienced SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant with 9+ years of expertise in SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, global template rollouts, business process analysis, and SAP implementations. The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, conducting workshops, gathering requirements, configuring SAP SD solutions, supporting testing activities, and ensuring successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Lead workshops with business users and stakeholders to define functional requirements.
Configure and support SAP SD processes, including Sales, Shipping, Delivery, Billing, Pricing, and O2C.
Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation and global rollout projects.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for developments.
Support SIT, UAT, defect resolution, cutover, and post-go-live activities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including MM, FI, WM/EWM, and Logistics.
Create and maintain functional documentation and provide end-user support.
Ensure solution quality, process compliance, and timely project delivery.

Required Skills
9+ years of SAP SD Functional experience.
Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
Experience in SAP implementations, enhancements, and global rollouts.
Expertise in Sales Order Processing, Pricing, Shipping, Delivery, and Billing.
Experience in business process analysis, configuration, testing, and production support.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of SAP integration with MM and FI modules.

Preferred Candidate
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation projects.
Exposure to Agile or SAP Activate methodology.

Description:
Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
Designation : Business Analyst
Location : Bangalore & Navi Mumbai Location

Responsibilities :
Business Analyst would be responsible for working closely with the Business Teams and helping them in making data driven decisions. This would require cross-communication between the Business Team, Product Team & Data Engineering as well. Apart from solving the business problem at hand, a Business Analyst would also be responsible for sharing insights and learning basis the data exploration/mining and convert these into clear action points and ensure that the same are being worked upon
Getting business requirements from the respective Business Teams, identifying the
underlying business case and building a generalized solution
Extracting & Exploring the data from database and other sources that may exist,
cleaning the data for any issues/missing values also needs to be owned upon
Converting the cleaned data into actionable insights and sharing the same with relevant
Audience
Automation of data problems/solutions that occur recursively
Flagging to Data Engineering in case of data sanity issues are to be seen
Ensure that the action insights shared with the business teams are worked upon
Ensure new business requirements are thoroughly vetted and signed off
Knowledge sharing within the team and outside if required

What are we looking for ?
2 to 4 years of work experience in the relevant field, preferably in a consumer facing company
Proficient in SQL and/or HQL , ability to handle complex/inner queries
Hands-on with Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (basic data cleaning, pivoting and data exploration)
Must have worked on any one Data Visualization Tool (Tableau, Power BI, Microstrategy, Metabase etc)
Basic automation skills using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel are expected
Hands on Knowledge of Python programming and Python for Data Analytics
Working knowledge on Machine Learning and Data Science Algorithms are a plus
Communication skills to get the business requirements and give out the final insights
Data Inquisitiveness

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Description:
Job Title: Sales Associate
Job Location: Nagpur
Experience: 3-6 Years
Industry: Medical Devices / Healthcare / Ophthalmology / Consumables
Function: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Sales Associate Consumables to drive sales growth and strengthen the market presence of our consumables portfolio in the assigned territory.
The role will be responsible for achieving sales targets, developing new business opportunities, managing customer and channel relationships, monitoring market and competitor activities, and ensuring strong customer retention and satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales plans and strategies for the assigned territory.
Track sales pipeline, forecasts and achievement against targets.
Identify new key accounts and direct trade opportunities.
Manage and develop relationships with dealers, distributors and customers.
Drive sales growth and ensure achievement of territory targets.
Maintain pricing discipline and ensure timely payment/collection as per company policies.
Monitor competitor activities, pricing, schemes and market positioning.
Maintain accurate sales and market information in SFDC/CRM.
Work closely with Marketing for RTM, CME and Live Surgery activities.
Collaborate with Equipment Sales, Marketing and other internal teams to drive cross-selling and synergy sales.
Maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics and customers within the assigned territory.
Prepare and submit regular sales reports, forecasts and market updates.
Contribute to customer retention, satisfaction and overall territory growth.

Candidate Requirements
Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
3–6 years of experience in Ophthalmology, Healthcare, Medical Devices or Consumables.
Strong experience in field sales / territory sales.
Experience in hospital, clinic, institutional or B2B sales will be preferred.
Experience managing dealers, distributors or channel partners.
Strong sales target orientation and business development skills.
Good commercial and strategic acumen.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong English communication skills.
Candidates with ophthalmic/eye-care consumables experience will be preferred.

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Customer focus: Driving Net.

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification:Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

We're looking for energetic and customer-focused Sales Executives to visit customers' homes, conduct eye tests, and sell Lenskart spectacles.
As a Sales Executive, you'll:
Visit customers' homes based on scheduled appointments
Conduct eye tests using specialized equipment
Sell Lenskart spectacles and provide exceptional customer service
Carry a 20-25 kg bag with eye check equipment and eyewears
Meet sales targets and earn attractive commissions

Compensation Package:
Variable compensation based on sales performance
Travel allowances

Training:
30-days comprehensive training in Navi Mumbai on eye checkups and sales techniques
Candidates must be willing to stay/travel to the training location for 30 days
Support and product training

Requirements:
Graduate or Diploma holder
Fresher/Experienced
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to lift and carry equipment (20-25 kg)
Willingness to travel and work flexible hours
Must possess a valid driving license
Must own a bike (two-wheeler)

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Candidates should have 8-10 years of SAP ABAP on HANA development experience, with mandatory experience in upgrade project.
Strong skills in classical and OO ABAP are required, along with proficiency in modern SAP development paradigms such as CDS Views, AMDP, RAP, and OData services. Extensive experience with the ABAP Workbench, data dictionary objects, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, and ABAP Proxy is also required.
Knowledge of SAP performance analysis tools (Code Inspector, ATC checks), and general business processes in core SAP modules (SD, MM and Costing) is expected.

Description:
Role: Technical Trainer
Location: Zonal office (Chennai), Training Office (Kochi)
Reporting to: Training Manager
Team name: Talent development
About the Team and the Role: The Talent development team at Ather is responsible for upskilling dealer staff and ensuring technical proficiency across the service network.
This role is for a Technical Trainer who will conduct technical training for new hires, manage refresher courses for new product launches, and support the creation of service manuals and diagnostic content.
Responsibilities
Conduct technical new hire training, refresher sessions, and update training for dealers on new product launches.
Maintain training spaces, vehicles, tools, and equipment to ensure an optimal learning environment.
Support the creation of training content, including photoshoots, videos, and service manual improvisations.
Evaluate the technical abilities of dealer staff and identify opportunities for upskilling.
Participate in man-hour improvisation processes and develop tools to reduce service costs and time.
Support Design for Service (DFS) activities by providing hands-on feedback on proto-parts or vehicles.
Provide field support for complex technical issues that cannot be resolved at the dealership level.
Drive the adoption of the Learning Management System (LMS) and provide technical support to the field team.
Experience and Qualifications
Diploma or Engineering in a technical background.
Minimum 1 year of experience as a technical trainer in the Automobile service industry.
Must Have Competencies
Understanding of electrical and mechanical components and circuits with hands-on technical experience.
Simplification of complex technical information into digestible, logical steps for varied audiences.
Utilization of Dealer Management Systems (DMS) and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
Execution of electronic diagnosis and troubleshooting to resolve ground-level product issues.
Good to Have Competencies
Development of technical training content including instructional videos and service manuals.
Implementation of man-hour improvement strategies and cost-effective service tool development.
Facilitation of Design for Service (DFS) feedback loops between field operations and engineering.
Coordination of large-scale training rollouts for new vehicle initiatives and updates.
Want to know more?
At Ather, we’ve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
Be You, With Us
The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.
