Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager


The Associate Agency Development Manager (AADM) is responsible for recruiting, training, and developing a team of insurance agents to achieve sales targets and drive business growth. The AADM will work closely with agents to enhance their skills, ensure compliance with company policies, and support their professional development. The role involves building strong relationships with agents, providing ongoing support and motivation, and monitoring performance metrics to guide agents toward success.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new insurance agents to build a strong agency team.
- Provide comprehensive training and ongoing mentorship to agents, covering product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer relationship management.
- Develop and implement business plans and strategies to achieve sales targets.
- Monitor and evaluate agent performance, providing constructive feedback and support to enhance productivity.
- Foster a positive team culture and motivate agents to reach their full potential.
- Conduct regular meetings and performance reviews with agents to discuss goals, challenges, and opportunities.
- Collaborate with management to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
- Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities to adapt strategies accordingly.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build and maintain relationships.
- Leadership and team management capabilities to inspire and guide agents effectively.
- Sales acumen with a proven track record in achieving targets and driving revenue.
- Problem-solving skills to address challenges and find solutions proactively.
- Familiarity with insurance products and services, particularly in life insurance.
- Proficient in using CRM software and other digital tools for tracking performance and managing agent relationships.
- Ability to analyze data and generate reports to inform decision-making.
- Basic knowledge of regulatory requirements in the insurance industry.
- Self-motivated and goal-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Willingness to travel for recruitment and training purposes, as needed.

This position is ideal for individuals looking to make a significant impact in the insurance sector by developing a successful agency team and contributing to the overall growth of Axis Max Life Insurance.

Description:
As a Relationship Manager - CAT - Elite at Axis Max Life Insurance, you will play a crucial role in managing and nurturing relationships with high net worth customers. Your primary responsibility will be to understand their financial needs and provide tailored insurance solutions that meet their specific requirements. You will act as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through various insurance products and helping them make informed decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

- Build and maintain strong relationships with elite clients to achieve sales targets and maximize revenue.
- Conduct detailed financial assessments to identify clients insurance needs and provide appropriate solutions.
- Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer engagement and satisfaction.
- Provide ongoing support and advice to clients post-sale to ensure long-term retention.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and address customer inquiries.
- Stay updated on industry trends, market developments, and competitor offerings to effectively position products.
- Facilitate product presentations and educational sessions for clients to enhance their understanding of insurance offerings.

Skills and Tools Required:

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively engage with high net worth clients.
- Excellent sales and negotiation skills with a proven track record in financial services or insurance.
- Ability to analyze financial data and provide customized recommendations.
- Proficiency in CRM software and other analytical tools for tracking client interactions and sales performance.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
- Knowledge of insurance products, financial markets, and regulatory standards.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
- Relevant educational qualifications in finance, business administration, or related fields.

This role presents a unique opportunity to work with some of the most prestigious clients in the industry, driving both your personal growth and the success of Axis Max Life Insurance.

Description:
Job Title: Windows Administrator - Desktop Support

Experience: 2+ Years
Location: Bangalore / Any Location
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Windows Administrator with strong Desktop Support and Troubleshooting expertise to join our IT team. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in managing Windows operating systems, end-user support, hardware and software troubleshooting, Active Directory administration, and IT infrastructure support. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth operation of desktop systems, providing technical assistance to users, and maintaining Windows-based environments.

Key Responsibilities
Windows Administration
Install, configure, and maintain Windows 10/11 operating systems.
Manage user accounts, groups, and permissions through Active Directory.
Perform regular system updates, patch management, and security compliance checks.
Monitor system performance and resolve operating system-related issues.
Maintain domain-joined systems and troubleshoot Group Policy issues.
Desktop Support
Provide L1/L2 technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, VPN, and application-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve incidents through ticketing tools within defined SLAs.
Install, configure, and support business applications and productivity tools.
Support user onboarding, offboarding, and workstation setup activities.
Troubleshooting & Incident Management
Investigate and resolve Windows operating system errors and performance issues.
Troubleshoot Office 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and other Microsoft applications.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring technical issues.
Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate teams and track resolution.
Asset & Documentation Management
Maintain inventory of IT assets and software licenses.
Document troubleshooting steps, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
Ensure compliance with company IT policies and security standards.
Required Skills
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 administration.
Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server basics.
Good understanding of Microsoft 365 administration and support.

Description:
AEL is DMarts ecommerce venture which is engaged in the business of online grocery retail under the brand name DMart Ready. AEL currently operates its business in select areas of Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat & is poised to launch its operations in Indore & Bhopal. AEL allows its customers to order a broad range of grocery and household products through its mobile app DMart online grocery shopping and through the website www.dmart.in. Customers can either 1) Self Pick Up: Order online from the app and pick up the order from the nearest DMart Ready Pick-Up point. 2) Home Delivery: Place your order online and get it delivered to home or office at a convenient date &time of choice.


Key Responsibilities
1. GST Compliance & Filings
Manage multi-state GST compliance frameworks across retail channels.
Oversee the timely filing of monthly, quarterly, and annual returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-8 (e-commerce), and GSTR-9/9C.
Execute 3-way reconciliations across Sales Registers vs. GSTR-1, Purchase Registers vs. GSTR-2B, and ERP ledger balances to optimize Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilization.
Monitor e-Way bill issuance, e-invoicing workflows, and GST rates.

2. Direct Tax & Regulatory Compliances
Oversee end-to-end Direct Tax, including monthly TDS/TCS deduction, deposit, quarterly return filings (Form 26Q/27Q), and annual Form 16/16A issuance.
Assist in annual Tax Audits (Form 3CD), corporate tax computations, advance tax forecasting, and tax provision reviews in coordination with statutory auditors.

3. Litigation & Dispute Resolution
Draft robust technical replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), audit inquiries, assessment orders, and notices from State/Central GST authorities.
Represent the company before tax officers, appellate authorities, and auditors during assessments, proceedings, and personal hearings.
Partner with external legal counsel, tax advisors, and consultants for high-stakes litigation, appeals, and legal opinions.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
Experience: Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in Indirect Taxation.
Technical Skills: Strong mastery of GST laws, legal drafting, ITC reconciliation methodologies, TDS/TCS provisions, and advanced Excel. Hands-on exposure to SAP is required.
Looking for CA Inter

Interested candidates can share their cv on pranali.dhanawade@dmartindia.com

About the Role
We are seeking a skilled AI/ML Engineer with expertise in agentic AI workflows and LLM-powered applications . The ideal candidate will design, build, and optimize AI-driven solutions for the healthcare and life sciences domain, ensuring accuracy, scalability, and compliance.

Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript .
Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen .
Familiarity with AWS AI/ML services: Bedrock, SageMaker, Textract, Comprehend Medical .
Proficiency in API integration and event-driven architectures .
Experience in healthcare/life sciences AI solutions with understanding of regulatory and compliance standards (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.) preferred.
Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to experiment, iterate, and optimize rapidly.

Description:
About the Role
We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer with hands-on experience in designing and deploying AI/ML solutions on AWS. You will build agentic AI systems, fine-tune LLMs, and operationalize ML workflows for real-world applications. This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AWS AI/ML services, collaborate across data and MLOps teams, and deliver production-ready intelligent systems at scale.
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad
Work Mode: Hybrid (2 days work from office is mandate)
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy ML models for agentic AI use cases (LLM orchestration, RAG, embeddings).
Build and optimize data preprocessing pipelines for structured, unstructured, and streaming data.
Implement LLM fine-tuning, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.
Integrate ML models into production APIs and applications.
Collaborate with data engineers to ensure clean, reliable, and scalable training datasets.
Partner with MLOps teams to automate training, testing, deployment, monitoring, and model governance.
Evaluate and optimize models for accuracy, scalability, cost-efficiency, and performance.
Conduct experimentation, A/B testing, and validation to ensure reliability.
Maintain documentation of experiments, pipelines, and best practices for reproducibility.
Required Skills & Qualifications
4-6 years of ML engineering experience (flexible based on seniority).
Strong programming skills in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle (data preprocessing training deployment).
Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services: SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis.
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), NLP, embeddings, and vector search.
Experience with ML pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, or similar).

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you''ll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what''s possible. Exposure to IIoT and Digital Manufacturing solutions.

Experience working as an MES SME, Business Analyst, or Product Owner.

Experience in requirement gathering, UAT, and release planning activities.
What You''ll Love About Working Here
Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation programs.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Age group: 21-28 years
Preferably has own conveyance

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager


The Associate Agency Development Manager will be responsible for recruiting, training, and managing a team of insurance agents. This role focuses on driving sales and developing new business opportunities through effective relationship management and strategic interventions. The individual will work closely with agents to enhance their productivity and achieve sales targets. Responsibilities include overseeing the performance of the agency team, implementing motivational strategies, and fostering a customer-centric approach to service delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and build a high-performing team of insurance agents.
- Conduct training and development sessions to improve agents sales capabilities.
- Monitor and evaluate team performance against set sales targets.
- Develop and implement strategies to enhance agency productivity.
- Foster a positive team environment through effective communication and motivation.
- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Proven sales acumen and ability to drive business growth.
- Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Solid understanding of the insurance industry and market dynamics.
- Ability to mentor and develop talent within the team.

Tools Required:
- Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Experience with CRM software and sales management tools.
- Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools.
- Ability to use digital communication platforms effectively.
- Knowledge of insurance-specific software and applications.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for growth and the chance to make a significant impact in the agency development landscape within Axis Max Life Insurance.

Description:
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


The Associate Agency Development Manager will play a crucial role in recruiting, training, and developing a team of insurance agents. The individual will be responsible for driving sales and achieving business targets by fostering a high-performance culture within the agency. This position requires building strong relationships with agents and providing them with the necessary support and tools to succeed in the competitive insurance market. The Associate Agency Development Manager will also focus on implementing marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility and drive customer acquisition.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and develop a team of high-performing insurance agents.
- Provide training and ongoing support to agents to ensure they meet their sales targets.
- Monitor performance metrics and carry out regular performance reviews.
- Implement strategic plans to drive business growth and enhance agency productivity.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with agents and clients.
- Develop and execute local marketing initiatives to promote products and services.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations and customer satisfaction.
- Stay updated on industry trends and changes in regulatory policies.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
- Proven experience in sales or insurance, preferably in agency development.
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Ability to motivate and mentor a diverse team.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Adaptability to changing market conditions and organizational needs.

Tools and Technologies:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software.
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis and reporting tools.
- Insurance industry software and platforms.
- Social media and digital marketing tools.

Candidates who possess a passion for sales, a deep understanding of the insurance industry, and a commitment to developing others will thrive in this role.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic Associate Agency Development Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing a team of agents, driving sales performance, and ensuring that the agents are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed. You will be required to create a robust pipeline of potential clients and work towards achieving both individual and team sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit, train, and mentor a team of insurance agents.
- Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve sales targets.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback to agents.
- Build strong relationships with clients and provide exceptional customer service.
- Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for growth.
- Organize training sessions and workshops for agents to enhance their skills and product knowledge.
- Collaborate with other departments to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective relationship building.
- Leadership and team management capabilities.
- Sales and negotiation skills with a proven track record of achieving sales targets.
- Ability to analyze market trends and make data-driven decisions.
- Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
- Knowledge of insurance products and regulations will be an advantage.
- Self-motivated and results-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Join us at Axis Max Life Insurance and be a part of a dedicated team that is committed to growth and excellence in the insurance industry.
